people.imagined: In the Pill Room's second furnace room he lifts the lid of a little gourd to smell a wound pill. His sunburn never fades and his wrists are stained green to the cuff. Winter frost-roots lie on the bench.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a work bench in a furnace room, he holds a small brown gourd under his nose to smell a wound pill and glances up at the viewer, soft-spoken and a little shy, winter frost-roots lying on the bench. Face (most important: a ferryman's sunburn, a permanent deep tan across nose and cheeks, and herb-green stains up to the wrists): a young oval face with ruddy sun-browned cheeks and nose, gentle dark brown eyes, thin brows, a small mouth in a half-smile and a faint dimple. Hair: black, in a loose knot at the crown with a pine twig through it. Body: slim and a little stooped from the bench, narrow in the shoulders. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, soft and clean, with a needle-green sash and the sleeves rolled to the elbow, and a clean cloth work apron tied over it. Hands and objects: both hands stained green to the wrist; in them a small round brown gourd with a wooden stopper; on the bench in front of him a row of tiny clay jars and a few dried roots. Background: a warm blurred furnace room with a red glow at the back. Light: warm firelight from the lower right mixing with daylight from the upper left, so the sunburn glows on his nose. Expression: a humble, patient, kindly face, the half-smile hesitant and the eyes lowered then lifted, the look of a man who would rather be useful than noticed.

people.imagined: A hard clear morning on the training ground. She has just won another duel and does not smile about it. Her father's black blade rides across her back.
people.subject: The moment: tall and upright on a bare training ground on a hard clear morning, she looks straight at the viewer with her chin raised, having just won another duel and not smiling about it. Face (most important: a long black flying blade across her back, its hilt and a hand's length of scabbard clearly at her shoulder, her father's): a sharp-featured narrow face with high cheekbones, a long straight nose, strongly straight black brows, narrow dark eyes with a level, challenging stare, a thin firm mouth and a small scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, pulled tight into a high tail with a plain green cord, a pine twig pinned at the base of the tail. Body: tall, long-limbed, fit and straight as a post. Clothing: a short patrolman's coat of undyed pine-bark linen with a standing collar and close-fitting sleeves with leather bracers, a needle-green sash with a second narrow green cord, and plain well-made boots. Hands and objects: one hand resting on the pommel of the black blade over her shoulder; a small knot of grey cord is tied on the scabbard. Background: a pale dawn sky and a few pine tops above the bare ground. Light: cool morning light from the upper left, sharp on the cheekbone and the black scabbard. Expression: proud and unsmiling, the mouth a thin straight line, the stare steady and cool, the look of a woman who expects to win and expects it to be noticed.

people.imagined: Alone in the Hall of Voices he is mid-song, the long chronicle running in his deep voice, his lips moving even as he listens to the echo.
people.subject: The moment: alone in the Hall of Voices, seated cross-legged, he sings the long chronicle with his mouth open and his head tilted slightly back, then lowers his eyes to the viewer. Face (most important: a bald head and a deep chest, a small frame with a big voice): a thin lined face with a smooth, tanned, shiny bald scalp, large ears flat against the skull, fine veins at the temples, a long grey-white beard split into two thin braids, heavy lids, dark patient eyes and a wide mouth open in song with the lips rounded. Hair: bald, with only a few white eyebrow hairs. Body: thin, narrow-chested and upright, the throat swelling slightly with the note. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, clean and soft, with wide sleeves, the collar neatly crossed at a small wooden pine-cone toggle, and a grey-green sash marking him an elder. Hands and objects: both hands laid on his knees; a small wooden pine-cone clapper on the floor beside him. Background: a dim hall of tall pillars of unpainted wood with a long bare floor of pale boards that carries the echo, and a single low lamp. Light: soft low lamp light from the upper left, putting a gold sheen on his scalp and a long soft shadow of his small body on the floor. Expression: a deep, patient absorption, the eyes lowered and the whole face given to the sound, honest and withdrawn, listening to his own echo.

people.imagined: In the outer gate yard, with a hundred children before her, she calls across the whole yard without raising her voice. A pine-cone pin holds her hair.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bright yard with one arm lifted as if signalling a class, she turns her face to the viewer with a brisk, warm smile. Face: an alert round face with strong cheekbones, quick dark eyes with laugh lines, neat black brows, a wide mouth with the corners lifted, a little sweat at the temples. Her cheeks are firm and her eyebrows straight and black, and a little sweat at the temples shows she has been shouting across the yard all morning. Hair: black with a few grey strands, in a tight bun with a pine-cone hairpin carved from wood and bigger than usual. Body: compact, brisk, straight-backed, strong shoulders. Clothing: a clean undyed pine-bark linen robe with sleeves tied back by cords, a grey-green sash since she is a steward, a leather satchel strap across the chest. The sleeves are held back by two grey-green cords crossed at the back, and a small bag of pine nuts hangs at her satchel strap. Hands and objects: the right hand raised, palm out in a class signal; the left holds a long thin teaching rod of pale pine. Background: a sunlit yard with a row of small children blurred in undyed robes. A long packed-earth yard stretches behind her with rows of cross-legged children in undyed robes, and a low line of roofs and tall pines beyond. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. The clean morning sun casts a sharp shadow of the teaching rod across her robe. Expression: patient, just and gregarious; a clear commanding warmth.

people.imagined: Late at night he sits with a cup he has not yet drunk and a fresh bruise on his forearm. He is trying to find the one sober dusk in which to say what he heard.
people.subject: The moment: slumped on a bench with a small empty cup in both hands, he looks up at the viewer with red-rimmed eyes, a fresh bruise on his cheekbone. Face (most important: a drinker's red nose and a purple-yellow bruise on the left cheekbone): a heavy, square, tired face, a big bulbous red nose with fine broken veins, a fresh bruise on the left cheek, thick grey-flecked brows, sad small brown eyes, a drooping mouth, a short stubbly beard. His eyes are red-veined, his lower lids sag, and the stubble on his jaw is mixed grey and brown, with a nick on the chin. Hair: dark brown going grey, short and messy. Body: heavy, broad and slumped, thick neck. Clothing: a patrolman's short coat of undyed pine-bark linen, rumpled but clean, a needle-green sash, a leather cord at his neck bearing a small round bronze token; he wears it always. The coat has a missing toggle, replaced by a bit of string, and the bronze token on its cord is worn smooth and dull from his thumb. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round an empty clay cup; on the left hand wrist another bruise. Background: a dim mess hall with a lantern. A bench along a plank wall holds a row of cups, one overturned, and a plain wooden door is just visible at the edge. Light: low lamplight from the upper left. The lamp makes the bruise on his cheek look darker, and the red of his nose is warm in the light. Expression: cautious, loyal, honest; heavy with something unsaid.

people.imagined: In the mess he roars a joke across the tables. The whole room knows he has arrived. He is grinning at the person he is about to shout at.
people.subject: The moment: mid-shout, his mouth wide open and his chin forward, he leans toward the viewer with a swaggering grin. Face (most important: a huge open shouting mouth with a square jaw): a broad, brutal, ruddy face with a thick jaw, a wide-open mouth with strong yellow teeth, a flattened nose, small gleaming eyes, thick eyebrows raised high, a cattle-herder's weathered cheeks. His ears stick out under the cropped hair, his neck is thick with a vein standing out as he shouts, and a scar cuts through his left eyebrow. Hair: close-cropped black, a cowlick. Body: big, thick-necked and broad. Clothing: a patrolman's short coat of undyed pine-bark linen with the collar open, a needle-green sash tied loosely, sleeves pushed up showing hairy forearms and a leather bracer. The coat's collar is open to show a hairy chest and a cord with a rough wooden cattle bell, and the bracer on the forearm is cracked leather. Hands and objects: one fist hammering on a table; the other hand holding a wooden cup half raised. Background: a noisy blurred mess hall with figures and lanterns. Rows of long wooden tables fill the hall and tin bowls and cups gleam among them, with a roar of figures in the haze. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left. Smoky warm light fills the hall and puts a sheen of sweat on his forehead. Expression: cruel, arrogant and warlike; loud pleasure in his own voice.

people.imagined: On the practice range, he holds a bow up to his ear and tests the string against his puckered left ear before he trusts it. A row of boys waits behind.
people.subject: The moment: he holds a bow beside his face and touches the bowstring to his left ear, listening, looking at the viewer from the side of his eye. Face (most important: a puckered, scarred left ear where the string touches it): a lean, hard, sunburnt face with a long nose, a firm thin mouth, hooded dark eyes, crows' feet, a short grey stubble; the left ear thick and puckered with pale scar tissue. His lips are thin and cracked by wind, the eyelids are creased and hooded, and he squints along the bow with one eye half closed. Hair: black streaked with grey, cut short, a pine twig pinned into a small knot. Body: lean, wiry and stiff-backed. Clothing: a short patrolman's coat of undyed pine-bark linen with a stiff collar, a needle-green sash, leather arm guards, a quiver strap crossing the chest. His arm guards are of dark horn plates laced with cord, and the quiver is of plain brown leather, worn glossy. Hands and objects: a long plain bow of dark wood held at the face, the string plucked by one finger against his ear; a quiver of grey-feathered arrows at the shoulder. Background: a pale field with straw targets in a row. Straw targets stand in a long row, some pierced by many arrows, and a rope marks the firing line in the grass. Light: clear morning light from the upper left. The morning light slants across the bow and picks out the grain of the dark wood. Expression: diligent, loyal, callous; calmly exacting.

people.imagined: She brings a ferry about hard and laughs; passengers grip the rail. A coin is flipped on the gunwale to decide who boards.
people.subject: The moment: at the steering oar of a ferry, she throws her head back laughing, a coin flashing in the air above her hand. Face (most important: a huge laughing mouth and a coin spinning above her fingers): a round, wind-tanned, handsome face with a wide laughing mouth, strong white teeth, bright dark eyes narrowed in mirth, thick brows, a gold-brown skin with freckles. Her neck is strong and tanned and her teeth flash white, with fine laugh lines fanning from the outer corners of her eyes. Hair: black, in a long braid thrown over one shoulder, a pine twig in the braid; wind-blown. Body: sturdy and muscular in the shoulders. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat with the sleeves tied back, a needle-green sash, rolled trousers, bare feet on wet planks. A faded blue scarf is knotted at her throat and the sleeves are tied with wet hemp cord, and a small bone toggle hangs from her sash. Hands and objects: the right hand has just flipped a small copper coin that glints above it; the left holds the long wooden steering sweep. Background: a wide river, a rail and a blurred grey bank. The ferry's wooden rail curves in the foreground with a few passengers gripping it, blurred, and the far bank is a pale line. Light: bright light from the upper left, sparkling on water. Light flashes off the water and glints on the coin and her teeth. Expression: gregarious, brave and arbitrary; wide laughter.

people.imagined: On the dike in spring he walks with the flood-mark rod and leans on it only when he thinks nobody is looking.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a dike in spring, a tall marked rod in his right hand, he leans on it slightly and glances at the viewer, catching himself as if he thought nobody was looking. Face (most important: a tall pale pole banded with dark painted rings, the flood-mark rod): a long, weathered face with a hooked nose, a deep line on each cheek, a small moustache, grey-streaked brows, tired but watchful grey eyes, a firm jaw, grey stubble on the chin and sun-blotches at the temples. Hair: grey and black, in a small knot with a pine twig. Body: tall, bony and slightly lopsided from a stiff leg. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat with the hem darkened by water, a grey-green sash, leather gaiters wrapped in neat spirals of cord, a wedge of chalk in the pocket and a broad flat straw hat hanging on his back by its cord. Hands and objects: the tall pale wooden rod as tall as himself, banded with dark painted rings; the left hand holds a coil of rope. Background: a grassy dike sloping away in even green grass with a row of numbered posts, the river beyond under a grey sky, and a heron standing in the shallows below. Light: cool grey light from the upper left, making the wet mud shine and the painted rings on the rod stand out. Expression: a quiet, cautious pride, the mouth firm and the eyes tired and watchful, a stubborn diligence he does not admit to.

people.imagined: He walks the landing bent as if over a pan, scanning the ground for something dropped. He remembers the burning ferries.
people.subject: The moment: he stands slightly stooped, head down and forward, eyes scanning the ground, then looks up sharply at the viewer, still searching for something dropped and remembering the burning ferries. Face (most important: a stooped forward-bent back and a downward searching gaze): a lean, sun-hardened face with hollow cheeks, a long nose, deep-set dark eyes, thick brows pulled together, a tight vengeful mouth, a straggly black moustache, a small scar on the chin and a long old burn scar down the left side of the neck. Hair: black, tied in a tail with a faded green cord. Body: stooped, with the shoulders rounded forward and long arms. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat, faded by the river but sound, with a green sash, the hem wet from the shallows, the sleeves rolled, and a small leather pouch of rust-brown nails stitched with thick black thread at the belt. Hands and objects: one hand holds out a bent iron nail between two fingers; the other hangs low. Background: a muddy riverbank with a line of small pale wooden stakes along it and a flat-bottomed boat pulled up with a pan leaning against it. Light: grey overcast light from the upper left, flattening everything except a faint gleam on the wet mud and the iron nail. Expression: a hard, brooding gaze with a long memory behind the eyes, the mouth tight and the brows drawn, patient as a man who intends to wait years for his answer.

people.imagined: Entering a room, she counts the people before she speaks, the cord wound round her wrist moving with each count.
people.subject: The moment: at a doorway, her eyes flick left to right as if counting the people in the room before she speaks, a cord wound several times round her wrist moving with each count. Face: a narrow, pale, watchful face with a high forehead, level alert dark eyes, thin straight brows, a small precise mouth held shut, finely drawn thin lips, a slight pinch at the nostrils, a tiny vertical line between the brows and a small scar above the left eyebrow. Hair: black, smoothed back into a tight bun with a pine twig. Body: slight, upright and neat. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, closely tailored, with narrow buttoned sleeves and a grey-green sash for a steward, and a small bag of pearl-grey silk at the belt with a tiny drawstring of blue thread. Hands and objects (the cord is the lead): a long knotted tally-cord of pale blue thread wound five times round her left wrist, with tiny white pearls tied along it; the right hand lifted a little with one finger raised as if counting. Background: a lamplit manor hall, a long room with low tables and cushions and a few figures standing and sitting in rows, softly blurred. Light: soft lamplight from the upper left, throwing her shadow tall on the wall and gleaming on the pearls of the cord. Expression: a flat, exact, watchful look, the mouth closed and the eyes moving, the composure of someone who trusts only what she has counted herself.

people.imagined: She comes in from the lake smelling of lamp-oil and fish, one bright ribbon in her plain braid; she is counting her allowance in her head for her brother.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a basket on her hip, she looks at the viewer with an easy, warm smile, just in from the lake smelling of lamp oil and fish and counting her allowance in her head for her brother. Face (most important: one very bright scarlet ribbon tied in an otherwise plain braid): a round, sun-warmed face with a small straight nose, cheerful dark eyes, rosy cheeks, fine freckles, thick soft brows, a faint peel of sunburn on the nose and a calm, content mouth. Hair: black, in one plain long braid over the shoulder, the bright scarlet ribbon tied at the end and a pine twig at the top. Body: sturdy and soft, comfortable in herself. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, clean, with a needle-green sash and the sleeves tied up, a fish-scale gleam on one cuff, a small wooden fish toggle at the neck and a blue-thread stitch at the left elbow. Hands and objects: a flat reed basket on her left hip holding two silver fish and a small brass lamp with a glass chimney. Background: a lake shore at dusk with small boats carrying tiny lanterns rocking on the dark water and the far shore a low line with a few lit windows. Light: soft gold dusk light from the upper left, warm on her cheek and picking out the bright red of the ribbon. Expression: calm, content and generous, a relaxed half-smile and warm eyes, a girl comfortable in a plain life and glad to share what she has.

people.imagined: In the Array Hall's back room she draws an array in the air with one finger while talking, planting flags one by one for the crossing she was asked to lay.
people.subject: The moment: she speaks to the viewer while one forefinger traces a line in the air, her eyes on it, in the Array Hall's back room, planting flags one by one for the crossing she was asked to lay. Face (most important: the index finger, held up and tracing a faint glowing line in the air): a narrow, intelligent, sharp face with a long chin, high cheekbones, bright restless dark eyes, a firm thin mouth, small close-set ears, a line between the brows and a streak of chalk across the knuckles of the raised hand; a thin trail of pale green light hangs where her finger moved. Hair: black, in a neat high bun fastened with two pine twigs crossed. Body: slim, quick and upright. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, close-fitting, with narrow sleeves edged in a strip of sky-blue cloth, a needle-green sash, and a pouch of small flags at the belt with their plain pale poles showing, each wrapped at the top with thread. Hands and objects: the right forefinger extended mid-air; the left hand holds three small triangular green flags on short poles. Background: a back room with white chalk lines crossing the floor, small stones at the corners of a half-drawn figure, a lamp, and a window showing a pale sky. Light: pale light from the upper left, with the green trail casting a faint green shine on her cheek and hand. Expression: absorbed and exact, the lips pressed and the eyes bright, a quick ambition held in check by the need to finish the line correctly.

people.imagined: He has just lost a go game, chalk on his sleeve, one shoe untied. He sits back, calm and lazy, planning the array he will draw now.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a go board, leaning back with a lazy smile after losing a game, one shoe visibly untied beside him, already planning the array he will draw next. Face: a long, relaxed, boyish face with a lopsided easy smile, heavy-lidded dark eyes, thick tilted brows, a stubbly chin, a small gap between the teeth and a smudge of white chalk on the cheek and across the forehead where he scratched it. Hair: dark brown and messy, in a loose knot with a pine twig that has slipped. Body: tall, loose-limbed and slouched. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe slightly rumpled, a long ink-and-chalk stain down the left sleeve, a needle-green sash tied askew with a lopsided knot, white chalk dust on the sleeves and knees, and the hem trailing untidily over a bare ankle. Hands and objects: a white go stone held lightly between two chalk-dusted fingers; the board in front of him with a loose scatter of black and white stones; one shoe lying untied at his foot, laces trailing. Background: a plain wooden room in the evening with a low table, a paper window and a teacup pushed to the table's edge. Light: warm light from the upper left across the board, lighting the chalk dust floating in the air. Expression: a lazy, unbothered smile with the eyelids half lowered, the calm of a man who treats losing as the first move of a longer plan.

people.imagined: She grinds agarwood in a stone mortar in a haze of smoke; the palace cats have followed her in and sit round her feet.
people.subject: The moment: she grinds resin in a stone mortar, smoke curling around her, and a grey cat sits at her elbow; she looks up at the viewer serenely. Face: a soft oval face with smooth fair skin, gentle slanted dark eyes, a straight small nose, a quiet mouth, one fine line across the forehead; a veil of pale smoke at her cheek. Her cheeks are smooth, her eyes are half closed with a look of calm, and a tiny spot of brown resin shows at the corner of her mouth. Hair: black, loose and long, tied low with a green silk strip; smoke clings to it. Body: slender and calm. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, a needle-green sash, a smock over it dusted with brown powder, wide sleeves tied up. The smock is dusted with brown powder to the elbows, and a small wooden spoon and a brush hang from the sash, with a sprig of dried herb tucked in the collar. Hands and objects: both hands on a stone pestle grinding dark resin in a stone mortar; thin grey smoke spirals from a small brazier beside; a grey cat sitting at her side and another curled at her feet. Background: a dim, smoky room with shelves of small jars. Rows of small labelled jars stand on shelves behind her and a low charcoal brazier glows beside a cat's tail. Light: soft light from the upper left, a gold haze of smoke. The gold haze of smoke softens everything, and the light makes her sleeves glow at the edges. Expression: content, devout and temperate.

people.imagined: At the water's edge he repeats every instruction twice under his breath. His stammer eases with the tide at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: standing knee-deep at the edge of a shallow tide with his lips moving, he looks up at the viewer with earnest anxious eyes, repeating each instruction twice under his breath, his stammer easing with the tide at his feet. Face (most important: moving lips, whispering to himself, a worried earnest look): a young, thin, serious face with wide anxious grey-brown eyes, light brows slanted upward in the middle, a slightly open mouth caught mid-whisper, pale skin, a wind-reddened nose, pink ears from the cold and salt on his lashes. Hair: dark, damp from sea spray, tied in a short knot with a pine twig. Body: slight and a little hunched, the trousers rolled. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe darkened by the tide to the knee, a needle-green sash come loose with one strand trailing in the water, the sleeves rolled, and bare feet in the shallows. Hands and objects: both hands held flat at the waist, palms down over the water as if holding the tide; a small wet seashell tied on a cord at his neck. Background: a grey sea with a long low tide-line and a pale horizon, small waves lapping his legs, a line of wet pebbles along the beach and a half-sunk post beyond. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, showing the wet shine on his hair and the shell at his neck. Expression: an anxious, devout earnestness, the brows tilted and the lips moving silently, patient and withdrawn, a man at his calmest when he is alone with the water.

people.imagined: At the first furnace she hums the same three notes. Her fringe is singed short and she teases the man at the next furnace about his frost-roots.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a furnace, she hums the same three notes with her chin up and turns a sly glance on the viewer, a small ladle in her hand, teasing the man at the next furnace about his frost-roots. Face (most important: a singed short fringe, scorched brown at the ends): a pert, sharp face with a snub nose, quick dark eyes with a hard shine, thin brows, a wide half-smiling mouth, lips slightly parted for the hum, a smut of ash on the cheek, a smudge of soot on the chin and scorched ends of hair over the forehead. Hair: black, in a high tail with a green cord, the front fringe cropped short and burnt uneven. Body: small, strong and brisk. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a needle-green sash, the sleeves tied back with two cords, and a leather apron scorched at the hem and with a burnt spot near the hip, a small bone ladle hanging from the belt. Hands and objects: a long wooden ladle in the right hand resting over a glowing furnace mouth; a clay jar of pill paste in the left. Background: a red-lit furnace room with shelves of clay jars along the wall, a pot bubbling on a low stove and a bundle of dried herbs hanging from a beam. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower right, gleaming on her cheek and the tip of the ladle. Expression: a sly, impatient grin with a flicker of mischief, the glance sideways quick and the mouth tugging up, a girl who finds other people's slowness faintly funny.

people.imagined: At his counting desk in the resin town he tilts his ledger away from a passer-by; a thumb gilded with resin pitch rests on the page.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk, he tilts a ledger book on edge away from the viewer with one arm curled round it, eyes wary. Face (most important: a thumb gilded amber with sticky resin, held up against the ledger edge): a round, smooth, plump face with small shrewd eyes, a thin moustache, soft cheeks, a tight smile; a drop of amber resin on his chin. His fingers are short and soft, a faint shine of sweat is on his upper lip, and tiny droplets of amber cling to his moustache. Hair: oiled black, in a tidy knot with a pine twig. Body: soft and round, sitting forward. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe of good make, a grey-green sash since he is a clerk, a flat black cap, sleeves covered by cloth cuff-guards. A row of small ivory buttons runs down his vest, the sash is held with a small copper clasp, and his cuff-guards are of black cotton. Hands and objects: the left arm shielding the open book (no readable writing, only blurred lines); the right thumb pressed to the page, golden and shiny with resin; a small lump of amber on the desk. Background: a shop with barrels and clay pots of resin. Barrels stand in rows with their lids sealed and a few amber lumps lie on a scale pan, with a ladder to a loft. Light: warm shop light from the upper left, the resin glowing amber. The warm light turns everything amber and picks out the shine on his thumb. Expression: greedy, diligent, cautious; a guarded smile.

people.imagined: On the border fence he chalks a mark on his wrist at each post as he saw the surveyors do. He stands in the wind, stubborn.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a fence post with a stub of white chalk, he marks his own wrist as he has seen the surveyors do and looks at the viewer with a plain, honest scowl, stubborn in the wind. Face (most important: white chalk tally marks drawn in a row on the inside of the left wrist, held up): a square, weathered face with a thick neck, a short broad straight nose, steady brown eyes, a firm jaw with short dark stubble, a chapped lower lip, a long scar on the forehead and sun-creased skin at the neck. Hair: dark brown and short, with a pine twig in a little tail. Body: stocky, steady and square, planted in the wind. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat with the sleeves cut short, a needle-green sash, leather bracers of dark leather with brass studs, tough leather boots with scuffed toes, a leather pouch of chalk sticks at the belt, and a coil of survey rope over the shoulder. Hands and objects: the left wrist held up with five short parallel white chalk strokes on the skin; the right hand holds the chalk stub. Background: a plain wooden fence running over a grey-green hillside with pines and a small cairn of stones, a thin mist lying in the valley. Light: cool clear daylight from the upper left, showing the white chalk marks sharply against the brown skin of his wrist. Expression: a plain, honest scowl, the brows low and the jaw set, brave and stubborn, a man who will mark every post himself rather than trust a report.

people.imagined: Warden of the mine, at the mine mouth with green dust in his beard; he smiles slowly at a pine growing out of the rock he has left alone.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a mine mouth, he strokes his beard with one hand and smiles slowly at the viewer. Face (most important: a beard turning green at the roots, plainly bright malachite green near the skin): a broad, lined, kindly face with a heavy brow, small deep-set eyes, a big nose, a grey beard shaded green at the roots, dust in the wrinkles. His hands are thick and scarred and his cheeks are ruddy, with white hairs of the brows tipped faintly green. Hair: grey, thin, under a cloth cap tied with green cord. Body: broad, a little stooped from the low tunnels. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat, sturdy, with a grey-green sash for his rank, sleeves green with dust at the cuffs, leather apron. The leather apron is stained with green streaks and the pick's handle is worn smooth, with a small brass lamp hung from his belt. Hands and objects: the right hand in the beard; the left holds a small iron pick with a short handle and a lump of bright green stone. Background: a dark mine mouth in grey rock with a single pine growing beside it. Timber props frame the mine mouth, with a cart on rails standing in the shadow and a few loose chunks of green stone by the track. Light: dim light from the upper left, a green gleam on the stone. The green sheen of malachite shows on the lump in his hand and on the beard roots. Expression: content, diligent and humble.

people.imagined: At the broken cliff in spring, alone, she calls names into the rubble and waits. A streak of white shows in her black hair.
people.subject: The moment: standing before a broken cliff, her head slightly tilted, as if listening for an answer. Face (most important: a bold white streak in her black hair, from the brow back): a composed, pale oval face with gentle level brows, calm dark eyes with a faint wet shine, a small steady mouth, soft lines at the eyes. Her lashes are long, her eyes are slightly red, and her small mouth is steady, with a smooth pale forehead. Hair: black with a single broad white streak running from the front hairline back, in a plain low knot with a pine twig. Body: slender, still, upright. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe of excellent cut, with a needle-green sash, the sleeves wide, a plain grey-green shawl. The shawl is plain pale grey-green and pinned with a wooden pin, and the sash is tied in a precise bow, her sleeves falling to the wrists. Hands and objects: both hands folded at her waist holding a little tea bowl of grey stone with a thin curl of steam. Background: a broken cliff face of grey rubble, fallen blocks, pale sky. Large grey blocks and splintered beams lie piled against the cliff, and a few small wildflowers grow in the cracks. Light: clear cold light from the upper left. The cool light lies evenly on the broken stone and gives her white streak a silver sheen. Expression: calm, forgiving and diligent; listening.

people.imagined: On the caravan road, he smiles a moment after everyone else's has gone, tallying who would pay for what.
people.subject: The moment: on a caravan road at dusk, he lets a late easy smile slowly spread across his face while looking at the viewer, a moment after everyone else's has gone, tallying who would pay for what. Face: a good-looking, smooth, open face with a high forehead, long lashes, long-lidded bright brown eyes that stay steady, a thin neat moustache, a smooth jaw, a small scar through the left brow, a trace of road dust in the creases of the smile and a sly slow smile. Hair: black, in a tidy knot with a green silk cord. Body: tall, easy and relaxed in the saddle. Clothing: a short patrolman's coat of undyed pine-bark linen, well tailored, a needle-green sash, a leather riding glove tucked into it, and a strap with a polished brass buckle. Hands and objects: one hand holds a horse's rein; the other lifts a small cup of wine slightly toward the viewer in a salute; a small bell hangs from the saddle. Background: a caravan road with a line of canvas-topped wagons and resting oxen blurred behind him, blue-purple hills and dusk. Light: low orange evening light from the upper left, picking out the rim of the cup and the glint in his eyes. Expression: a pleasant, unhurried smile that arrives a beat late, warm on the mouth and entirely calculating in the eyes, an agreeable man who will sell any promise at its price.

people.imagined: She sits on the retreat's top step between sweeps with her broom across her knees, grey hair coming loose, listening to her old master cough at dawn.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stone step in the early morning with a broom of pine twigs across her knees, she looks up at the viewer with gentle patience, grey hair coming loose, listening to her old master cough at dawn. Face (most important: grey hair, pinned loosely, and a blue-grey apron): a kind, plain, lined face with a soft round chin, pale grey-brown eyes, warm laugh lines, thin silver brows, a small round mole beside the nose, a quiet small smile and a pine needle caught in the hair. Hair: grey, pinned up in a loose bun with a pine twig, a few silver hairs escaping. Body: small, sturdy and round-shouldered, square red hands from work. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, clean, old and soft, a grey-green sash with a bunch of keys on a cord at her waist, and over it a blue-grey cotton apron dusted with pine needles. Hands and objects: both hands lie on a broom of bound pine twigs across her lap; a small pottery tea cup stands on the step by her. Background: a stone staircase strewn with pine needles and moss, tall trunks, morning mist, a small wooden bucket by the wall and a faint line of smoke from a chimney above. Light: soft pale light from the upper left, making her grey hair glow and picking out the straw of the broom. Expression: a calm, humble, loyal gentleness, the small smile settled and the eyes soft, a woman content to serve the same house for her whole life.

people.imagined: Asleep on a bench with the satchel clutched in his arms like a doll. A boy wakes him and he grins, still holding it.
people.subject: The moment: half-awake on a bench, he hugs a leather satchel tight to his chest with both arms and blinks at the viewer with a cheerful sleepy grin. Face (most important: a battered leather satchel hugged in both arms against his chest): a round sunburnt friendly face, a wide mouth with a gap tooth, quick bright eyes, a small moustache, creases from the road. His hands are chapped and his eyes have faint dark circles, and a small scab marks his chin. Hair: black, tousled, in a short knot with a pine twig tilted. Body: stocky, travel-worn, bowed shoulders. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat, travel-dusted but sound, a grey-green sash, a wide straw hat hanging at his back, strong boots. The satchel strap has been mended with leather thongs, and his boots are caked with road dust, with a small clay dog-whistle on a cord. Hands and objects: both arms wrapped round a thick brown leather satchel with brass buckles, no writing; his chin on top of it. Background: an inn porch with a lantern and a dog sleeping. A porch with a wooden post and a lantern shows behind him, and a brown dog is curled up asleep on the boards. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. The lantern casts a warm circle that lights his grin and the brass buckles. Expression: gregarious, honest and a touch greedy.

people.imagined: In the workshop, he hums to the grain as he carves, then stops when he sees he is watched. Shavings curl at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: carving a beam with a small adze, he looks up as if caught humming, and stops. Face: a lean, warm, thoughtful face with a straight nose, calm brown eyes, laugh lines, a short dark beard with wood shavings in it, a shy flicker of a smile. His hands are broad with square nails and a thumb stained brown with oil, and tiny curls of wood rest in his beard. Hair: dark brown, in a topknot with a carved pine twig. Body: lean and strong in the forearms. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket with sleeves rolled, a needle-green sash, a leather apron full of shavings and a loop of tool pouches. His sleeves are caught up with a leather strap and a narrow chisel is stuck behind his ear, with a pencil of charcoal in the apron pocket. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small curved adze with a polished wooden handle, the left on a half-carved pale beam with a coiling grain pattern; curled shavings in his hair and at his feet. Background: a workshop with beams, a hanging saw and a window of daylight. A big beam with a half-finished pattern lies on trestles, with a saw hanging on the wall and a broom in the corner. Light: gold light from the upper left, wood dust in the beam. The dust in the sunbeam glitters and lights the curl of shaving on the blade. Expression: diligent, content and stubborn.

people.imagined: In the market she counts you with her eyes like a woman counting coin, a pleasant smile fixed. She keeps two sets of letters.
people.subject: The moment: in a market lane she looks the viewer up and down once, quickly, with a pleasant smile that does not move. Face (most important: eyes that count, a steady head-to-toe appraising glance): a handsome, narrow face with level dark eyes that flick, thin, finely drawn brows, a high forehead, a small pleasant mouth with a smile set like paint; clear skin, a tiny mole at the lip. Her ears are small, her lips are neat, and her eyes seem to rest on the viewer's purse, with a tiny gold stud in one earlobe. Hair: black, in an elegant high coil with a pine twig and a small jade bead. Body: slender and composed. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, well cut, with a needle-green sash, a rope purse at her belt, wide sleeves. The sleeves are lined in pale grey silk and a thin silver chain loops from her sash to the purse, with fine pale shoes. Hands and objects: one hand holds a closed bamboo basket; the other rests on the purse, thumb moving on the cord. Background: a bright blurred market, awnings and baskets. Rows of baskets and bright cloths hang at the stalls behind her, and a seller is arguing with a customer, blurred. Light: bright market light from the upper left. The light makes her pleasant smile look like painted porcelain. Expression: faithless, deceitful and cautious; a sweet, empty smile.

people.imagined: She walks as if carrying a full bowl even with empty hands, her master's zither slung heavy at her back; she has noticed it weighs too much.
people.subject: The moment: she steps with careful smooth steps, both hands held at belly height as if carrying a full bowl of water, looking at the viewer. Face: a calm, round, gentle face with level brows, steady dark eyes, a slightly furrowed forehead of concentration, a small quiet mouth. Her lips are pale and her eyes are fixed ahead, with a faint line between the brows as she balances an imaginary bowl. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a pine twig; no loose strands. Body: slight, poised, with the long neck of a dancer. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, clean and exact, a needle-green sash, a long dark strap crossing the chest to carry a long cloth-wrapped zither on the back, its end showing above her shoulder. The strap of the zither is padded with a strip of folded cloth at the shoulder, and the sash is wound with a plain cord, with soft felt shoes. Hands and objects (the zither is the lead): a long zither wrapped in plain pale cloth on her back, one end clearly above the shoulder; both hands curved empty as if holding a bowl. Background: a forest path of soft green shade. A green path winds between slender trunks and a few pale fallen leaves lie on the moss. Light: dappled light from the upper left. The speckled light moves across her cheek and the cloth of the zither case. Expression: diligent, loyal and humble.

people.imagined: In the paper shed he stands in a drift of birch-bark curls, pressing a sheet flat with the side of his hand; curls cling to every fold.
people.subject: The moment: standing among drying sheets in the paper shed, he looks over his shoulder at the viewer, calm and quiet, pressing one sheet flat with the side of his hand while curls of pale birch bark cling to every fold. Face (most important: pale birch-bark curls clinging to hair, sleeves and shoulders): a pale oval face with a straight nose, faint thin dark brows, calm heavy-lidded eyes, a mild closed mouth and one curl of bark stuck on the cheek and another at the lower lip. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders, curls of bark caught in it. Body: slim, soft and stooped slightly. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with bark curls caught in its folds, a needle-green sash, the sleeves tied with bark string, a small flat knife in the belt, and a long cloth apron smeared with brown resin and ink. Hands and objects: one hand pressed flat on a pale drying sheet of birch-bark paper, blank; more sheets hang behind him on cords. Background: the shed itself, rows of birch-bark sheets hanging from lines, pots of resin in a corner and a sack of curls. Light: soft, almost white light from the upper left that gives the whole picture a papery glow. Expression: a quiet, diligent calm, the eyes heavy and the mouth mild, withdrawn and unhurried, a man who has spent his days in this shed and likes it that way.

people.imagined: At the gold-washing landing, sun-dark, with a red thread tied round her wrist. She turns it as she looks at a stranger's face and wonders whom it belongs to.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the water's edge with a shallow pan in her hands, she lifts her head to the viewer, the pan tilted. Face (most important: a bright red thread tied round the left wrist, plain against the dark skin): a sun-darkened, lined, strong-boned face, steady black eyes under thin brows, a wide mouth in a careful smile, pale gold specks in the skin at the temples. Her eyes are black and bright, her mouth is wide with a small scar at the corner, and tiny gold flecks sparkle on her cheek. Hair: black, tied up in a scarf of undyed linen, a pine twig through the knot. Body: small, wiry, strong. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat with a grey-green sash since she is a steward, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a leather apron wet to the waist. The apron is of wet leather and the sleeves are rolled with bands of cord, and a small bag of gold-dust hangs at her belt. Hands and objects: a wide shallow wooden gold-pan with a glitter of gold flecks in wet sand, held in both hands; gold dust in the creases of her knuckles; a red thread tied round the left wrist. Background: a river shallows with reeds and washers blurred. Reeds stand in the shallows and a line of washers crouches in the water, with a flat-bottomed boat tied up. Light: bright river glare from the upper left. The glare from the river puts a bright glow on her face and the gold in the pan. Expression: generous, cautious and deceitful; a gentle mask.

people.imagined: In council she speaks to the elders as if across a frozen lake. She wears the ice-cutter's apron and has never sat out a whole meeting.
people.subject: The moment: standing up in a council hall with a fist raised, she calls out loudly to the far side of the room, looking at the viewer. Face (most important: a big mouth open in a shout, and a leather ice-cutter's apron over broad shoulders): a broad strong face with a wide jaw, a prominent nose, thick straight brows, fierce clear grey eyes, a big open mouth, wind-reddened cheeks. Her cheeks are red from the cold, her neck is thick, and a faint scar of frost-burn crosses her chin. Hair: black, in a tight thick braid wound round the head, a pine twig. Body: tall, big-shouldered, powerful. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up on strong forearms, over it a heavy brown leather apron with a frosted rim, a needle-green sash. The apron's rim is rimed with frost and her sleeves are rolled to show forearms thick as a man's, with a big iron buckle at the belt. Hands and objects: the right fist raised; at her belt a small iron ice-hook. Background: a hall with pale wooden pillars and blurred elders in grey-green. Long benches and pillars of pale wood stand behind her, and a line of grey-green figures sits at the far end, blurred. Light: bright light from the upper left. The light is bright and falls across her raised fist and the frost on the apron. Expression: ambitious, just and impatient; blunt force.

people.imagined: In the yard, mid-sentence, he turns his head toward the pines on the hill, hearing something longer than the primer.
people.subject: The moment: in the yard, he stops mid-word and turns his head sharply toward the pines on the hill at his side, mouth a little open, eyes distant, hearing something longer than the primer. Face (most important: a head turned sharply to the side, listening, one ear toward the trees): a thin, sensitive, boyish face with large dark eyes wide and unfocused, a long nose, a soft parted mouth, sunken cheeks, big ears, a smudge of sap on the forehead and temple and a long thin neck holding up the head. Hair: black, in a rough cut, with a pine twig through a short tail. Body: skinny with bony shoulders and a long neck, a growing boy. Clothing: a clean undyed pine-bark linen robe he has outgrown, short at the wrists, sap stains on both sleeves with dry pine needles stuck to them, a plain rope belt and no sash, a leather thong round one wrist. Hands and objects: one hand raised halfway, fingers spread, as if asking for quiet; a small hatchet at the belt. Background: a line of dark tall pines topping a green hill, wind in the boughs, a thatched roof at the foot with a thin plume of smoke. Light: cool, thin light from the upper left that seems to hang in the air like a hush before wind. Expression: a far-away, listening calm, the face open and honest and a little humble, the look of a boy who has heard something no one else has.

people.imagined: He lounges outside the kitchen with a basket of lake fish bought with his sister's allowance, a silver fish scale stuck to his cheek like a beauty mark.
people.subject: The moment: he lounges against a wall holding a string of fish, and grins easily at the viewer. Face (most important: a single bright silver fish scale stuck on the cheekbone like a beauty mark): a round, lazy, cheerful face, a wide easy grin, sleepy dark eyes, a flat nose, a scatter of freckles, a shining oval scale on the left cheek. His ears are round, his nose is flat, and he has a lazy dimple near the mouth, with a glinting silver scale stuck on the cheek. Hair: black, flat and messy, a pine twig stuck in at an angle. Body: soft, relaxed, sprawled. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, plain, no sash, sleeves rolled, a fish-scale glint on the cuff, bare ankles. The robe is stained with fish-scale glitter on the cuffs and the sleeves are crooked, with a bit of reed grass sticking from the collar. Hands and objects: a string of four silver lake fish held up in the right hand, glittering. Background: a kitchen doorway with steam and baskets. A low wall of stacked baskets lies behind him and steam rises from a big pot with a woman's arm showing. Light: warm light from the upper left. The warm light makes the fish scales shine like coins. Expression: lazy, content and gregarious.

people.imagined: Crossing the open yard he keeps the low slow stoop of the mine as if the ceiling were still above him.
people.subject: The moment: standing in an open sunlit yard with his head down and his shoulders drawn forward as if under a low roof, he looks up at the viewer with a serious face, keeping the low slow stoop of the mine as if the ceiling were still above him. Face: a square, plain, earnest young face with a broad forehead, heavy brows, small steady grey eyes, a straight stubborn mouth, a short neck, cracked hands and grey rock dust lining the creases of the forehead and ears. Hair: black, short and sticking up. Body: short and thick-shouldered, bent forward at neck and back in a deep miner's stoop. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe stained grey at the knees and elbows, with leather knee guards sewn on for crawling, no sash, strong low boots, a greasy flat leather cap held in the hand and a lantern hook at the belt. Hands and objects: one hand carries a small cloth bag of bright green stone chips; the other hangs, scarred across the knuckles. Background: a bright yard of pale gravel, bare except for a handcart, with a distant pine and a low door in the far wall black with shadow. Light: bright sun from the upper left casting hard shadows under his brow. Expression: a stubborn, honest seriousness, the brows low and the mouth flat, a diligent boy who has not yet learned that the sky is allowed to be above him.

people.imagined: He taps the tiger-claw charm at his throat as he says the word tiger. He has never seen a tiger; the one he saw was a dog.
people.subject: The moment: tapping a charm at his throat with one finger, he looks at the viewer with a bold, boastful grin. Face (most important: a curved yellow tiger-claw charm on a cord at the throat): a handsome, proud, cocky face with a straight nose, thick dark brows, a strong jaw, bright confident eyes, a quick white grin; a small gold earring in one ear. His ears have a small gold ring in one, his nose is straight and high, and his teeth are even and bright. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a green cord. Body: well built, upright, a little swaggering. Clothing: a short inner-disciple coat of undyed pine-bark linen, tailored, a needle-green sash, a leather bracer on the left forearm. The coat has silver stitching along the collar and the bracer is carved with a tiger pattern, with a neat jade pendant at the belt. Hands and objects: the right forefinger tapping a large curved yellow-white claw on a leather cord at his neck. Background: a training yard and a stretch of dark pines. A yard of swept earth lies behind him, with a rack of wooden practice swords and dark pines beyond. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. The bright sun gleams on the claw and on his gold earring. Expression: brave, deceitful and arrogant; boastful confidence.

people.imagined: Standing in her aunt's ferry with the oar over her shoulder, calling out the fare before anyone has asked, freckles to the hairline.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a small ferry boat with an oar across her shoulders, mouth open calling out the fare before anyone has asked, one palm held out for coin. Face (most important: freckles thick from nose to hairline, a bold open mouth, the palm out for payment): a round, bright, sun-freckled face with freckles so thick they join into blotches and reach the hairline, wide hazel eyes, quick arched brows, a pointed chin, a snub nose and a cheeky wide mouth mid-call, a smile that is all business. Hair: red-brown, in two braids tied up with green cord. Body: small, strong and quick, the sleeves rolled. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jerkin with a needle-green sash, trousers rolled to the knee, bare feet and a wet hem, the sleeves tied up with wet cord, a small knife in a sheath and a string of copper coins at the belt. Hands and objects: the left palm held out flat in front of her; the right hand grips a long oar resting across her shoulders. Background: a wide river with reeds and water lilies lining the bank and a pale line of distant roofs on the far shore. Light: bright river light from the upper left, sparkling on the water and making her freckles look like gold dust. Expression: a cheerful, gregarious haggling grin, chin up and eyes dancing, a girl who enjoys the price almost as much as the passage.

people.imagined: He sniffs the air before rain, flood rod in hand, and is right; the village children call him Muddy Jaw and he answers.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a tall rod, his chin lifted and nostrils flared, he sniffs the air and glances at the viewer. Face (most important: a very long jaw, blotchy skin, and ears set too low and sticking out): a plain, long, awkward face with a long blotchy red-and-pale jaw, a big nose lifted into the air, ears set low and flaring, small mild eyes, thin uneven brows, a tight patient mouth; not made handsome. His chin is long and uneven, and the dark blotches on his jaw run into his neck, with a few stray hairs on the upper lip. Hair: brown, cut straight and short, with a pine twig in a stubby tail. Body: lanky, narrow-chested, long-necked. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, clean, a plain rope belt, a straw rain-cape folded over one shoulder. The robe is clean but short in the arms, and the straw rain-cape has been mended with new yellow straw, with a small notebook of wood slats at the belt. Hands and objects: both hands hold a tall flood-mark rod banded with dark paint, the end planted in mud; his head is tilted back. Background: a dike and a heavy grey sky with a darker cloud approaching. The dike has a line of numbered stakes and long grasses bending in the wind, with a flock of birds flying low. Light: grey storm light from the upper left. The dark storm light turns the grass silver and shows the paleness of his skin. Expression: cautious, patient, loyal; unbothered by the nickname.

people.imagined: She lights the dusk incense stick when her mother's hands shake, a small pale mark on her cheek where a censer spark once landed.
people.subject: The moment: bending slightly, she touches a glowing taper to a thin incense stick and looks up at the viewer in the light of it. Face (most important: a small round pale scar on the left cheek, the size of a lentil, from a censer spark): a soft, sweet, oval face with a gentle chin, clear dark eyes, softly arched brows, a small mouth lifted at one corner, a pale round mark on the cheek. Her eyes are dark and soft, her lashes are long, and a faint tint of smoke shadows her eyelids. Hair: black, in a long braid over one shoulder with a green ribbon, a pine twig. Body: slim, graceful, bent forward. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a needle-green sash, wide sleeves caught up with cord, a thin grey scarf of incense smoke curling about her. The sleeves are tied back with a green silk cord and a tiny brass censer-bell hangs from her sash, with a fine thread of smoke in the cloth. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a slender stick with a glowing red tip; the left holds a tiny brass taper with a flame. Background: a dim incense hall with soft smoke. Shelves of brass censers and bundles of unlit sticks stand behind her, and a low window lets in a shaft of light. Light: warm taper light from the lower right and soft light from the upper left. The warm taper glow lights her cheek and the pale mark, and the smoke makes gentle haze. Expression: temperate, devout, quietly cheerful.

people.imagined: At midwinter, wet from the sea, salt crusted on his eyebrows, he stands unshivering where the keepers turned back.
people.subject: The moment: standing wet and bare-armed on a winter shore, he looks calmly at the viewer, unshivering. Face (most important: white salt crust frosting both eyebrows, and wet hair with no shiver): a calm, square, tanned face with thick brows white with dried salt, steady dark eyes, a wide straight mouth, a small scar on the chin, pale salt dried at the temples. His jaw is square and his lips are blue from cold, and white crystals of salt line his lashes and the line of his hair. Hair: black, plastered wet to the skull. Body: stocky, strong, relaxed shoulders, bare forearms. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe soaked dark and clinging, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, a needle-green sash heavy with water, bare feet in cold surf. The robe is bleached white at the seams from salt, and the sash is wound with cord, with a small knife at the belt. Hands and objects: both arms hang loose; a small cord with a white shell at the throat. Background: a grey winter sea and a white horizon with breaking waves. Waves break in lines of white foam on dark sand, and a few gulls hang in the grey air. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. The cold light is flat and shows his breath hanging in a faint cloud. Expression: brave, content and reclusive; calm as stone.

people.imagined: She wipes her hands on her hair, as always; the broom stands taller than her. She has learned forty recipes by listening at the door.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a broom much taller than herself, she wipes her palms on her hair, as she always does, and looks at the viewer with a bright, hungry eagerness; she has learned forty recipes by listening at the door. Face (most important: a broom twice her height standing at her side): a small, thin, bright, freckled face with big dark eyes, a pointed chin, a quick sly smile, dust on the cheek and strands of hair stuck up from being wiped. Hair: dark brown, a bit greasy and tufted, tied in a small knot with a cord. Body: tiny and wiry, a little over-quick, standing on her toes. Clothing: a clean undyed pine-bark linen robe with plain cuffs and no sash, and a cloth apron gone grey with ash. Hands and objects: a tall broom of bundled twigs at least a head taller than she is, held upright in one hand while the other wipes her hair; a small copper-lidded jar hangs at her belt. Background: a corridor of a furnace room with a faint glow behind a half-open door, and shelves of jars in shadow. Light: warm glow from behind the door mixing with daylight from the upper left, rimming her tufted hair. Expression: a bright, hungry, humble eagerness with a touch of greed in the sidelong glance, the look of a clever girl who knows how much she has learned and how little anyone has noticed.

people.imagined: Asked a question, he stands blinking, the answer still walking toward him; he is better at the chores than the primer.
people.subject: The moment: standing with an armful of firewood, he looks at the viewer with a slow, patient blink, mouth just beginning to open, asked a question to which the answer is still walking toward him. Face: a broad, open, placid face with wide-set brown eyes, thick brows raised mildly, a plain round nose, a slightly slack mouth with chapped lips, big low ears, a bit of bark on the brow and a look of kind blankness. Hair: black, short and shaggy, with a bit of bark in it. Body: broad, solid and tall for his age, a country boy better at chores than the primer. Clothing: a plain undyed pine-bark linen robe with the sleeves rolled and no sash, the elbows polished pale by wear and wood-chip dust on the front, a plain rope belt and a woollen scarf wound twice round the neck. Hands and objects: both arms around a bundle of split pine firewood, the bark pale and rough, with an axe stuck through his belt. Background: a woodpile reaching to the roof of a shed with a pile of chips in front, a small brown dog nearby, and a distant hill with pines. Light: soft warm daylight from the upper left lying on his broad face like a blessing. Expression: a delayed, gentle look, the eyes steady and the mouth just parting, brave and honest and content, entirely without hurry.

people.imagined: She falls asleep with shavings in her hair and wakes with them in her bed; today she is bent over a fallen pine, feeling the grain.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a fallen pine, she runs a palm along the grain and looks up with a stubborn frown; she falls asleep with shavings in her hair and wakes with them in her bed. Face (most important: pale wood shavings curled all through her black hair): a narrow, determined, freckled face with a straight nose, strong straight brows drawn low, alert hazel eyes, a firm mouth, a tiny scar on the left cheek and shavings stuck to the cheek. Hair: thick black hair in a loose tail with many pale curled shavings tangled in it. Body: lean with strong forearms, crouched low. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with the sleeves tied up with twine, a plain cord belt, and a leather apron with sawdust down the front and a roll of small chisels hanging at the belt. Hands and objects: one palm flat along a split fallen pine, the other holding a small mallet; a half-carved wooden bird sits on the log. Background: a workshop yard with stacked beams, a half-built frame and the distant roof of a hall. Light: bright light from the upper left showing each curl of shaving and the grain of the log. Expression: a stubborn, honest frown of concentration, the lower lip pushed forward, diligent to the point of forgetting there is anyone watching.

people.imagined: Asleep on watch among the grain sacks, a crust in his pocket; he wakes to find a mouse on his knee and names it.
people.subject: The moment: slumped on a grain sack, half-awake with one eye open, he finds a small grey mouse on his knee and has just named it, a crust in his hand, asleep on watch among the sacks. Face: a round, sleepy, content face with plump cheeks, heavy drooping lids, a short nose, grain dust whitening his eyebrows so that he looks old, and a slack smile. Hair: brown and rumpled, white with grain dust. Body: soft, round-shouldered and sprawled comfortably. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket without a sash, brown trousers with floury cuffs, a granary guard's leather strap across the chest, and a bulging pocket with a thread of crumbs trailing from it. Hands and objects: a stale crust in the right hand, the left lifting two fingers toward the mouse on his knee; a short wooden staff with a worn leather grip leans beside him. Background: stacked grain sacks rising to a high rafter in a dim granary, a few slits of sunlight crossing the dusty floor and a small stone mouse-hole. Light: dusty beams from the upper left glowing gold and picking out the mouse on his knee. Expression: a lazy, very comfortable half-smile, the one open eye soft and amused, a content man who sees no reason to stand up while there is bread.

people.imagined: On horseback, the whip uncoiled across his saddle, he looks over the village with a flat cold eye; the wolf tooth gleams at his throat.
people.subject: The moment: mounted, he looks down at the viewer from the saddle, one hand resting on a long whip coiled across the saddle front. Face (most important: a wolf-tooth charm on a cord at the throat, and a cold flat stare): a hard handsome young face with a sharp jaw, a straight cruel mouth, narrow pale eyes, thin eyebrows, a scar across the upper lip; the wolf's tooth, thick, yellow and curved, hanging at his collar. His nose is hooked, his cheeks are hollow, and his lashes are pale so his eyes seem almost white. Hair: black, cut short, a pine twig tucked above the ear. Body: tall, long-limbed and upright in the saddle. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen riding coat with leather shoulder pads, a needle-green sash, riding gloves, a horse's brown flank at the edge. The coat's shoulders are padded with dark leather and the saddle is decorated with a wolf-head stud, with the long whip of black braided leather. Hands and objects: a long black whip uncoiled and laid across the saddle, the right hand on its handle. Background: a dusty village road and low hills. A village of low houses with smoky roofs lies behind him and a track disappears into low hills. Light: harsh afternoon light from the upper left. The harsh sun makes the wolf tooth shine like bone and puts a hard shadow under his brows. Expression: brave, cruel and loyal; flat and calm.

people.imagined: Angry, she touches the plum-blossom scar on her forearm, the one the refused sword did not give her; she wants to prove them wrong.
people.subject: The moment: angry, she grips her own forearm with her thumb on a scar and glares at the viewer with stubborn defiance, wanting to prove them wrong. Face: a young strong face with a firm square chin, straight dark brows pulled low, bright proud dark eyes that burn, a tight mouth, flushed cheeks and a small cut healing on the lip. Hair: black, in a tight high tail with a green cord and a pine twig. Body: lean, hard-muscled and rigid. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a needle-green sash tied hard, the right sleeve pushed up and the other sleeve bound at the wrist with a strip of cloth. Hands and objects (the scar is the lead): the left hand holds the bared right forearm, where a pale scar shaped like a five-petalled plum blossom stands out plainly, as big as a coin; a sliver of dark iron is just visible at the sleeve cuff. Background: a pale gravel yard stretching to a row of dark pines, a wooden practice post standing to one side. Light: hard light from the upper left putting a sharp highlight on the scar and the clenched hand. Expression: angry pride, the jaw clenched and the dark eyes level, brave and stubborn and quietly dangerous, a young woman refusing to let a refused sword define her.

people.imagined: Walking the ten weeks back to the village of the dead pines, a damp-wrapped sapling in his pack, patient and calm.
people.subject: The moment: on a path, he kneels and carefully lifts a small damp-cloth-wrapped sapling from his pack, looking up at the viewer with gentle eyes. Face (most important: a pine sapling with a wet cloth wrapped round its roots, held in both hands in front of his chest): a mild, thin, kind face with soft brown eyes, level eyebrows, a long straight nose, a quiet gentle smile, sun-browned skin. His ears are small, his lips are chapped from the road, and a faint tan line shows where the hat usually sits across his brow. Hair: dark brown, in a neat top knot with a green cord, a pine twig. Body: lean and gently stooped, walking-worn. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a needle-green sash, dusty at the hem, a pack with wide straps on the back, a travel staff against the shoulder. The pack's straps are padded with folded cloth and his sandals are tied with new cord, and the sleeves are rolled twice at the wrist. Hands and objects: both hands holding a small pine sapling about a forearm tall with its roots wrapped in dripping cloth. Background: a country path with a row of young pines. A dirt path runs between young pines of equal height, each with a small wooden tag tied to a lower branch. Light: soft light from the upper left. The soft light is green-gold under the branches and shows the damp shine on the cloth round the roots. Expression: patient, devout and compassionate.

people.imagined: He stands as if a roll were being read over him, the clan-seal ring turned inward; he is ready to report each doubt.
people.subject: The moment: standing stiffly at attention as if a roll were being read over him, chin up, he looks at the viewer with cold composure, ready to report each doubt. Face (most important: a heavy silver clan-seal ring turned inward so only the plain band shows, on a rigid raised hand): a handsome, severe young face with a high nose, thin proud lips, level cold eyes, finely drawn brows, a faint sneer and a line of tension at the corner of the mouth. Hair: black, combed back and pinned in a tidy topknot with a jade pin. Body: tall, straight and rigid with the shoulders back. Clothing: a short inner-disciple coat of crisp undyed pine-bark linen with narrow tailored sleeves and a stiff, perfectly flat collar edged with silver thread in a plain wave, a needle-green sash with a jade clasp carved as a pine bough. Hands and objects: the left hand held up at chest height with the palm inward and the thick silver ring turned so its band shows; long pale fingers with a small ink stain on the right forefinger, and the right hand resting on the sash. Background: a stone hall of pale pillars with a polished floor that shows a faint reflection of his boots, and a screen of plain paper at the back. Light: cold, even light from the upper left that leaves no soft shadows and makes the face look carved. Expression: formal and calm, the lips thin and the eyes cool, ambitious and arrogant, a man who is already composing his report.

people.imagined: By the hot spring, towels over both shoulders and steam rising off her, she hears everything the old soakers say.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a hot spring with a pile of towels on both shoulders and a thin plume of steam around her, she smiles at the viewer with an eye on a bargain. Face: a round, rosy, shiny face from the steam, bright dark eyes, a snub nose, a wide cheerful mouth, damp curls at the temples. Her cheeks are shiny and pink from steam, her eyelashes are beaded with tiny drops, and a loose curl sticks to her temple. Hair: black, in two buns, damp and curling. Body: plump and warm, sleeves rolled. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe damp at the cuffs and collar, no sash, a leather coin pouch on a cord. The robe's sleeves are rolled and wet at the cuffs, and the coin pouch is hung from a cord crossed over her chest, with a small wooden clog on each foot. Hands and objects (the towels are the lead): white towels draped over both shoulders and over one arm, a stack of folded towels held against her chest, steam rising. Background: a hot spring pool with white vapour and grey rocks. Large flat stones ring the spring, with a wooden bench loaded with towels and a rack of clay cups. Light: warm light from the upper left, glowing in the steam. The warm light glows on the steam and gives her a soft halo. Expression: gregarious, greedy and indulgent.

people.imagined: In a heavy coat with antler buttons that he wears in the lowlands too; he tells people he has no friends and smiles calmly.
people.subject: The moment: standing quietly in a heavy coat that he wears even in the lowlands, he looks at the viewer sideways with a still, unreadable expression, a man who tells people he has no friends and smiles calmly. Face (most important: a thick fur-trimmed coat with ten big carved antler buttons in two rows down the front): a calm, wide, weathered face with high flat cheekbones, narrow dark eyes with a faint fold at the corners, a broad nose, a straight mouth with the faintest smile, wind-chapped cheeks and a few white hairs in the eyebrows from the northern wind. Hair: black and long, in a single braid tied with leather. Body: stocky and thick-chested. Clothing: a thick coat of grey reindeer hide and wool with a fur collar and ten big pale antler buttons, stitched with thick sinew thread and closed by a wide belt of plaited leather, over an undyed pine-bark linen undershirt with a needle-green cord. Hands and objects: a leather glove in one hand; the other rests on the coat's button row. Background: a pale green lowland field with a small herd of reindeer grazing, one blurred at the edge, and a thin line of smoke from a distant tent. Light: soft grey light from the upper left that settles on the fur like frost. Expression: a closed, quiet face, the mouth almost smiling and the eyes giving nothing away, calm and withdrawn, courteous in a way that keeps people at a distance.

people.imagined: He clicks the pocket abacus on its cord as he walks and calculates a tenth of the good lots; he is smiling at a customer.
people.subject: The moment: he holds up a tiny abacus on a cord and clicks a bead with his thumb, smiling at the viewer with calm greed. Face: a smooth, handsome, merchant's-son face with bright quick brown eyes, an easy broad smile, a neat thin moustache, sleek eyebrows, a cheerful sweetness that is practised. His fingers are slim and clean, the nails neat, and a small gold ring sits on his left little finger, with a smooth chin freshly shaved. Hair: black, oiled, in a high knot with a green cord. Body: slender, polished, upright. Clothing: an inner-disciple coat of undyed pine-bark linen, well tailored, a needle-green sash with a brass buckle, a clean white collar, a small brown leather satchel on a strap. The sash's brass buckle is stamped with a plain coin pattern and the satchel is stitched with fine gold thread, with a small pair of scales in his pocket. Hands and objects: a pocket abacus the size of a palm on a cord, held up in the right hand, one bead pushed over; the left hand holds a small lump of amber resin. Background: a resin warehouse with stacked barrels. Rows of sealed barrels stand with amber lumps on top, and clerks bend over a bench, blurred, in a high warehouse. Light: warm light from the upper left. The warm light shines on the amber and picks out a gleam on the abacus beads. Expression: greedy, ambitious and gregarious; smooth sweet cheer.

people.imagined: He cannot stand still through a speech; a coin-sized hole in his sleeve where a smoking coin burned through; he is selling the rest of the old coins.
people.subject: The moment: fidgeting, half turned, he holds up a dull old coin between finger and thumb to the viewer with a quick bright grin, selling off the rest of the old coins, unable to stand still. Face: a thin, quick, impish boy's face with large bright eyes that dart sideways as if looking for the next buyer, a pointed nose with a smear of dust, ruddy cheeks, ears that stick out and a wide grin with a front tooth missing. Hair: black, wild and sticking out in several directions. Body: thin, wiry and restless, caught mid-step. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe a little too big, a coin-sized hole burned through the right sleeve with singed brown edges and a bit of grubby elbow showing through it (a smoking coin burned it, and he is proud of the hole), no sash, a leather bag on a strap and a string of old coins at the belt. Hands and objects: a flat round old silver coin with a square hole held up between thumb and forefinger beside his face; the other hand in the open pouch. Background: a pale yard with a crowd of pilgrims with bundles and staffs blurred behind him and a market stall under a tree. Light: bright sun from the upper left making the coin flash and putting a glint in his eye. Expression: a salesman's grin, quick and gap-toothed and a little shifty, the eyes bright with cheerful deceit and an appetite for company.

people.imagined: Between sentences she chews the end of her braid; she has just told a lie that she half hopes no one believes.
people.subject: The moment: she chews the tip of a braid held in her fingers and looks at the viewer with wide innocent eyes, between sentences, having just told a lie she half hopes no one believes. Face (most important: the end of the braid between her teeth): a young, pale, serious face with wide dark eyes, thin level brows, a small chin, small bitten lips, a faint crease of thought and a blotch of ink on the chin. Hair: long black hair in a single thick braid over the left shoulder, tied with a green cord, the chewed end damp. Body: slender and a bit hunched. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of undyed pine-bark linen with a needle-green sash tied in a bow with uneven ends, the sleeves a little too long over her fingers, and a small pouch stitched from good scraps of cloth at the belt for zither strings. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts the braid to her mouth; the left holds a bundle of thin silk strings loosely. Background: a hall of tall pale wooden pillars rising into shadow, a few cushions scattered on the floor and a silent zither case in the corner. Light: soft light from the upper left falling on the damp braid end and her wide eyes. Expression: a wide-eyed, calm innocence with the lips pressed around the braid, an earnest look that hides a small fib and invites you to believe it.

people.imagined: A measuring rope wound round her waist like a belt, she is quietly placing array stones better than the man she carries them for.
people.subject: The moment: crouching with an array stone in both hands, she sets it carefully in a chalk circle and glances up at the viewer, serious and exact, quietly placing array stones better than the man she carries them for. Face (most important: a coil of measuring rope wound round her waist like a belt, knots tied at regular marks): a lean, serious, plain face with a straight nose, careful dark brows with a faint crease between them, grey-brown eyes, a firm mouth and a smear of chalk on one cheek. Hair: black, in a tight braid pinned up with a pine twig. Body: sturdy and quarry-strong, in a crouch, with strong chalk-dusted hands. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of undyed pine-bark linen with the sleeves tied back with cord, chalk-white on the knees, a knotted measuring rope round her waist as a belt with a knot every hand's width and the ends tarred black. Hands and objects: both hands set a flat grey stone the size of a loaf in a chalk ring; a plumb-bob hangs at her side. Background: a bare floor drawn with white chalk circles and spoke lines, a wooden frame with a plumb line in the corner. Light: pale light from the upper left that shows the chalk lines with crisp clarity. Expression: a cautious, patient concentration, the mouth firm and the eyes on the stone, content to be exact and let others take the credit.

people.imagined: The stove boy has just dropped another bowl; he grins sheepishly, soot on his nose, shards at his feet.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a kitchen with a cracked ceramic bowl dropped half-way, he grins sheepishly at the viewer. Face (most important: a broad sheepish grin with soot on the nose and a ruddy fire-lit face): a round, ruddy, friendly face with a smudge of black soot across the nose and cheek, large honest brown eyes, a big awkward grin, thick brows, sweat at the temples. His ears are large and red, his lashes are long, and flour has settled in his eyebrows, with sweat drops on his upper lip. Hair: black, a mess, tied back with a rag.
