Body: big and gangly, long arms, careless. Clothing: a servant's tunic of plain brown cotton with the sleeves rolled, a flour-dusted apron over it, a cloth wrapped on the head; no sash. The apron's strings are knotted twice and the cloth on his head is a faded red rag, with a splash of soup on the sleeve. Hands and objects: a broken bowl in two halves held in both hands, a wooden ladle under the arm. Background: a kitchen with a red-lit stove, pots, steam. Hanging pans and bundles of dried peppers fill the wall, and a big iron pot sits on a low stove, with a steaming kettle. Light: orange stove glow from the lower right and soft light from the upper left. The stove glow lights his round cheek and the shards at his feet. Expression: gregarious, diligent and humble; embarrassed but cheerful.

people.imagined: In midsummer she wears gloves; the cup in her hand has frosted. She is a pledge, watchful and apart.
people.subject: The moment: holding a small tea cup in both gloved hands, she looks at the viewer with quiet reserve, a delicate frost on the cup. Face (most important: thin white gloves in midsummer, and a cup furred with white frost): a pale, fine-featured face with a high forehead, pale grey-blue eyes, thin pale brows, a small closed mouth, skin almost translucent with a faint blue tint at the temples. Her lips are pale pink, her fingers are long and fine, and a tiny snowflake of frost rests on her lower lashes. Hair: black, in a smooth long braid over one shoulder with a silver pin and a pine twig. Body: slight, upright, cool. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe of fine cloth, a needle-green sash, long sleeves covering to the wrists and thin white silk gloves. The gloves reach past the wrist under the sleeve, and the collar is lined with a thin strip of white fur, with a silver hairpin shaped like a snowflake. Hands and objects: a pale grey stone tea cup held in gloved hands, a thick fur of white frost on its outside and a little cold mist rising. Background: a sunlit summer window and green leaves, blurred. A window with a green summer tree beyond shows the heat outside, and a plain low table with a second untouched cup stands beside her. Light: warm summer light from the upper left that makes her seem cooler by contrast. The warm light makes the frost on the cup glitter and her skin look even paler. Expression: cautious, loyal and reclusive.

people.imagined: At the listening terrace at dusk she holds the taper over the dusk stick. An envoy has stopped mid-sentence under her stare.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still with a long taper held up, she fixes the viewer with a steady unblinking stare. Face (most important: a stare, steady and wide-eyed, unblinking): a lean, severe, handsome face with a high straight nose, wide level dark eyes with a stillness that is a little frightening, thin black brows, a thin mouth, a firm chin, ageless skin. Her cheekbones are high, her lips are thin and pale, and the lines of her face are smooth and ageless, with a faint shadow in the hollow of the cheek. Hair: black with a single silver strand, drawn back in a tight bun with a plain pine-wood pin. Body: tall, straight, quiet. Clothing: a long robe of undyed pine-bark linen with a grey-green sash, the collar high and plain, wide still sleeves. The collar is fastened with a plain wooden pin and the sleeves hang straight to her fingertips, with a belt of dark cord holding a small bell. Hands and objects: a long thin taper in her right hand, flame at the tip, held toward a bronze censer shaped like a pine cone on a stand, the incense stick unlit. Background: a terrace of pale wood at dusk, tall pines, a faint mist. Two tall pines frame the terrace, and a low bronze censer in the shape of a pine cone stands on a stone stand beside the rail. Light: gold dusk light from the upper left, the taper's flame warm on her face. The taper's flame sits steady and puts a tiny gold light in each eye. Expression: patient, devout and arbitrary; unnervingly still.

people.imagined: He sits with his back to the wall facing the door, a flattened chin from a mule-kick; he keeps the wine corked for a friend.
people.subject: The moment: seated square on a bench facing the viewer as if the viewer were the door, a hand near his belt. Face (most important: a flat, squashed chin, as if it had been pressed in): a heavy, wide face with a thick short neck, a chin flattened and pushed back into the jaw, deep-set angry brown eyes, a broken eyebrow, a wide tight mouth with a down turn, grey in the stubble. His eyes are small and brown with a heavy brow ridge, a grey streak runs through his stubble, and a scar crosses the bridge of his nose. Hair: dark grey, short, with a pine twig through a stubby knot. Body: wide-shouldered, solid, sitting upright, alert. Clothing: a patrolman's short coat of undyed pine-bark linen with leather shoulder guards, a needle-green sash, scuffed boots. The shoulder guards are of black leather and scuffed, and the cord at his sword hilt is wrapped with green thread, with the boots resting square on the floor. Hands and objects: one hand resting on a short sword hilt at the hip; on the table beside him a small corked clay wine jug pushed aside. Background: a dim guardroom with a door edge and a lantern. A plank wall carries a rack of spears and a single lantern hangs from a hook, with the door's edge showing a strip of night. Light: lamp light from the upper left. The lamplight is yellow and throws the shadow of his chin on his chest. Expression: loyal, wrathful and brave; watchful anger.

people.imagined: Walking the flood marks at night, mud on the hem, thinking of the brother whose name the palace will not sing.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a dike she holds a lantern low to read a flood mark on a post, and glances up at the viewer, calm and fierce. Face: a strong, level, grave face with high cheekbones, dark steady eyes with firm brows, a straight mouth, a long jaw; a small crease at the brow. Her cheekbones are strong, her eyes are dark and wet in the lamplight, and a streak of mud crosses her wrist. Hair: black, in a thick braid pinned round the head, a pine twig. Body: tall, strong, upright. Clothing (the mud is the lead): a clean undyed pine-bark linen robe with a thick band of drying dike mud up the hem to the knee, a needle-green sash, sleeves tied back; mud on her boots. The boots are black with mud to the ankle and the sleeves are tied with grey-green cord, with a small flask at the belt. Hands and objects: a paper lantern held low in the left hand, lighting a post painted with ringed marks; the right hand rests on the post. Background: a night dike, black water, distant lights. A line of numbered posts runs along the dike into the dark, and the river is a black sheet with a few distant lights. Light: warm lantern from below left, cool moonlight from the upper left. The lantern casts a warm pool on the post and a cool silver line of moonlight on her shoulder. Expression: just, calm and vengeful; quiet resolve.

people.imagined: At dawn on the ice edge, bone whistle at his lips, he blows for the lake children and counts them. He passed the test by one point.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a pale ice shelf at dawn with a bone whistle between his lips, eyes on the viewer. Face (most important: a pale bone whistle held in the mouth, cheeks puffed): a lean, weathered, earnest face with a long chin, windburnt cheeks, bright dark eyes, thick eyebrows raised slightly, a thin black moustache, a small scar on the temple. His nose is red with cold, his moustache is frosted at the tips, and his eyes are bright and quick. Hair: black, in a top knot with a green cord, frost on it. Body: wiry, long-legged, upright. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a thick grey wool coat over it, a needle-green sash, fur-lined mittens tucked in the belt, boots. The grey wool coat is buttoned to the throat with bone toggles and the mittens at his belt are lined with rabbit fur, with a short ice-chisel strapped to his back. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long white bone whistle against his lips; the left holds a coil of rope. Background: a frozen lake and a line of small children blurred in the pale dawn. Lines of small children in padded coats wait in rows on the ice, with holes cut for fishing and little stools set beside them. Light: cold pink dawn light from the upper left. The pink dawn light turns the ice rose and gold and glints on the bone whistle. Expression: ambitious, honest and impatient.

people.imagined: He plucks a bit of lint from his own sleeve before he looks at anyone's work, a frown of superiority on his face.
people.subject: The moment: he picks a thread of lint from his immaculate sleeve with two fingers and looks at the viewer down his nose. Face (most important: a pinched, fastidious face and a thin sneering mouth): a long, thin, pale, fine-boned face, a pinched sharp nose, narrow cold eyes, thin brows raised, a slight curl of the lip, a neat thin moustache. His fingers are long and pale and his nails are perfectly clean, and his cheeks are shaved so closely they seem polished. Hair: black, severely combed and bound in a tight high knot with a green silk cord, with a jade pin. Body: tall, straight and slim, immaculate. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe pressed perfectly, with a needle-green sash tied in a precise knot, white cuffs without a mark. The white cuffs fold exactly twice and the sash knot is a perfect flat square, with a small silver measuring tape of cord at his hip. Hands and objects: the right fingers pinch a tiny thread from the left sleeve; a measuring rod of dark wood under one arm. Background: a stone sluice with a faint reflection of water. Wet stones of the sluice rise behind him in neat courses, with a shining sheet of water falling over a lip. Light: cool clear light from the upper left. The cool light is clean and hard and shows not a crease in his robe. Expression: diligent, arrogant and cruel; cold superiority.

people.imagined: She carries the chimney brush in her belt like a sword and sweeps on the seventh day, grim about the canopy.
people.subject: The moment: standing guard in a furnace room with a long brush tucked through her belt like a sword, hand on its handle, looking at the viewer. Face: a lean, serious, sooty face with a long nose, narrow dark eyes, strong brows, a thin tight mouth, smudges of black soot across the forehead and cheek. Her hands are rough and scarred with small burns, and her cheeks are smudged with soot in streaks, with her lashes dusted grey. Hair: black, in a tight plain bun covered by a grey kerchief. Body: lean, wiry, upright. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, grey with soot at the cuffs, a needle-green sash, a leather apron, sleeves tied up. The robe's cuffs are black from the flue and the apron has a row of pockets with brushes in them, and the belt is a length of rope. Hands and objects (the brush is the lead): a long round chimney brush with black bristles and a wooden handle stuck through the belt at her left hip like a sword, her right hand on its handle; a tin lantern at her feet. Background: a furnace room with a tall black chimney and a reddish glow. A tall black chimney climbs the wall behind her and a pile of ash lies in a tin tray. Light: orange glow from the lower right, pale light from the upper left. The low red glow from the furnace makes her face look carved from bronze. Expression: cautious, diligent and reclusive.

people.imagined: She lifts a rolled incense stick to the light and sniffs it, noticing it burns a breath short.
people.subject: The moment: she holds a thin brown incense stick up against the light and sniffs it, eyes closed. Face: a gentle, calm, oval face with closed lids, long dark lashes, a fine nose slightly raised, a soft honest mouth, smooth cheeks; a dusting of brown powder on the chin. Her hands are fine and steady and the fingertips are stained brown, and she has a mole on her left cheekbone. Hair: black, in a neat coil with a pine twig and a few loose strands. Body: slim, steady-handed, seated at a table. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, a needle-green sash, sleeves tied back with cord, an apron smudged with resin. The sleeves are tied back with plain cord and the apron's pocket holds a tiny pair of scales, with a sprig of plum blossom pinned on her collar. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a slim incense stick to eye height, golden light passing through it; the left rolls a second stick on a flat wooden board; rows of identical sticks laid in a tray. Background: a quiet rolling room, bundles of sticks and little scales. Rows of drying sticks stand in racks and a small stone mortar sits on the table, with a window looking on a garden. Light: soft gold light from the upper left. The soft golden light passes through the stick and gives the room a warm calm. Expression: calm, honest and temperate.

people.imagined: He wears a cord of knots round his neck, one for every Thiên Xu boot print he has found; he stares suspiciously at the viewer's boots.
people.subject: The moment: crouched beside a patch of bare earth, he looks sharply from a boot print up to the viewer's face, suspicious. Face: a narrow, sharp, tanned face with a pointed nose, darting dark eyes, thick brows pulled down, a tight twitching mouth, stubble on the chin. His eyes are small and bloodshot with suspicion, his lips are thin, and a muscle ticks in his jaw. Hair: black, in a short knot with a pine twig. Body: wiry, tense, crouching. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat with a needle-green sash, leather gaiters, dirt on the knees. The cord of knots round his neck is about thirty knots, each tied with a different thread colour, and the gaiters are tied with leather thongs. Hands and objects (the cord is the lead): round his neck a long thick cord of rough hemp tied with some thirty knots, plain and clear against his chest; his right finger points to a boot print in dust; a small cloth bag of black and white stones at the belt. Background: a rough wooden fence on a hillside. A line of stakes marks the fence across a bare brown hillside, with a single crow standing on a post. Light: hard light from the upper left. The hard light shows a long shadow of the cord on his chest. Expression: paranoid, arbitrary and loyal.

people.imagined: On the mine floor with one ear pressed flat to the stone, listening for pine roots.
people.subject: The moment: lying on her side on a stone floor with her cheek and left ear pressed flat to the rock, eyes open and fixed on the viewer. Face (most important: the ear pressed flat on stone, and the face turned sideways): a calm, broad, stubborn face tilted sideways on the stone, small attentive dark eyes, a straight mouth, dust on the cheek and eyebrow, an ear that is flattened and pale. Her cheek is dusty, her eyelashes are heavy with stone grit, and her pressed ear is flat and white as a shell. Hair: black, in a tight braid coiled under a grey cloth cap. Body: stocky, lying prone, strong shoulders. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket stained grey-green with dust, a needle-green sash, leather knee guards, a small hand lamp beside her. The jacket is stained green and grey in blotches and the knee guards are of padded leather, with a coil of rope at her waist. Hands and objects: one hand flat on the rock beside her ear, fingers spread; a small brass lamp with a pale flame on the floor. Background: a dark mine gallery with timber supports. Dark timber props frame the gallery and a loose chunk of green ore lies beside her hand, with the lamp's reflection in a puddle. Light: dim lamp light from below and a pale glow from the upper left. The dim light from the lamp lights the underside of her chin and makes the stone shine. Expression: patient, stubborn and arbitrary; listening.

people.imagined: He jingles his key ring when he lies. Rice powder dusts his sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: he jingles a ring of keys in one hand and speaks smoothly to the viewer, eyebrows lifted, a placating smile. Face (most important: a heavy ring of iron keys held up and jangling, and rice powder on the sleeves): a plump, smooth, pale face with a double chin, small clever eyes, a little curled moustache, a mouth in a bland smile, shining cheeks. His cheeks are smooth and soft, his fingers are plump with a ring on each little finger, and a faint dust of rice powder lies in the creases of his neck. Hair: oiled black, under a small flat black cap. Body: round, well fed, sleek. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe of good make with a grey-green sash, sleeves dusted white with rice powder from the cuffs to the elbow, a large key ring at the belt. The sash is perfect and a heavy iron key ring hangs at his belt beside a small purse, with fine black shoes. Hands and objects: a ring with eight iron keys held up in the right hand; the left rests on a rice sack. Background: sacks of grain in a granary, high small window. Big grain sacks are stacked to the beams and a ladder leans against them, with sunlight slanting from a high window. Light: dusty light from the upper left. The dusty light makes the powder on his sleeves glow and the keys glint. Expression: pragmatic, greedy and callous; a smooth smile.

people.imagined: At an inn he scribbles in his notebook, wearing two boots that never match, in the middle of copying a vassal's complaint.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an inn table, he writes busily in a notebook and glances up at the viewer with a friendly flick of the eyes. Face: a pleasant, mobile face with a long nose, quick brown eyes, wide eyebrows, a ready smile with dimples, a day's stubble, ink on the chin. His lashes are long and his hands are quick and ink-stained at the fingertips, with a small notch in his left ear. Hair: brown, tousled, a pine twig askew. Body: lean, relaxed, restless. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen rider's coat, a needle-green sash, wind-dusted; one boot dark brown and the other pale grey, visible under the table. One boot is stitched with red thread and the other with black, and the notebook has a cord binding, with a stub of brush hung from his belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush above a small notebook with blurred lines of unreadable scribbles; a cup of tea at his elbow. Background: a lamplit inn, a few shapes of travellers. A wooden inn table has a tea tray and a candle stub, and a few shadowy travellers sit in the corner with a barking dog under a bench. Light: warm light from the upper left. The warm light of the inn glows on his face and the page of the notebook. Expression: gregarious, faithless and fickle; amiable.

people.imagined: Hoarse after ninety years of chanting, he corrects a boy who sang a line too far; he never asks where that line came from.
people.subject: The moment: with one finger raised, he corrects the viewer, his hoarse patient mouth open on a sung syllable, after ninety years of chanting, never asking where that line came from. Face: a long, lined, kindly face with a wispy white beard, deep creases at the mouth, heavy lids over tired rheumy brown eyes, a prominent Adam's apple with cords of strain at the thin neck, and a hoarse set to the throat. Hair: thin white hair in a small knot with a pine twig. Body: spare, bent slightly, with narrow shoulders and hands a little spotted with age. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, soft with washing and neatly kept, a grey-green sash with a wooden clapper hanging from it, and a grey wool scarf wound three times round the neck. Hands and objects: the right forefinger lifted in correction; the left holds a small wooden teaching clapper. Background: a packed yard with a line of small children in undyed robes sitting cross-legged, blurred, and a tall pine beyond the wall. Light: soft morning light from the upper left, kind to him and making the white hairs of his beard glow. Expression: a hoarse, gentle patience, the eyes warm and tired, a stubborn humility in a teacher who will correct the same line a thousand more times.

people.imagined: A ledger-clip hangs at her belt where a knife would; she has the clan's thin straight nose and drills her nephews to kneel on pine cones.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight and still, she looks down the long line of a thin straight nose at the viewer, a ledger-clip at her belt. Face (most important: a thin, long, straight nose in a cold severe face, and a metal ledger-clip at the belt): a gaunt, handsome, cold face with a long thin straight nose, thin cruel lips, narrow dark eyes, high arched brows, pale skin. Her cheeks are narrow and her lips are thin and colourless, and her eyes have a fixed measuring stare. Hair: black, in a tall severe knot with two black wood pins. Body: tall, straight and sharp. Clothing: a fine undyed pine-bark linen robe, narrow-sleeved, a needle-green sash, a black lacquered belt from which hangs a bright steel ledger-clip where a knife would hang. The sleeves are narrow with silver embroidered cuffs in a wave pattern, and the lacquered belt has a bright steel clip, with a fine pair of black shoes. Hands and objects: hands folded in front of her at the waist; the clip clearly shown at the belt. Background: a pale stone room, a shelf of blank ledgers. Rows of blank bamboo ledgers fill a shelf behind her and a plain lamp stands on a stone table. Light: cold light from the upper left. The cold light leaves her face in sharp planes. Expression: cruel, diligent and loyal; strict.

people.imagined: At the lower gates he counts villages off on his fingers while others talk of other things; his own village is third.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a sluice gate, he touches one finger after another on his left hand as he counts villages, his eyes on the viewer but far away; his own village is third. Face: a kind, tired, lined face with soft red-rimmed grey eyes, a drooping moustache, a high forehead with deep worry lines, a gentle mouth and weather-browned skin. Hair: grey and black, in a plain topknot with a pine twig. Body: medium build, thick-waisted, with a stoop and broad hands, the tip of the left ring finger missing. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat with a grey-green sash, the hem dark with river water, a straw hat on his back, a leather satchel on a plaited strap across his chest and a bundle of small wooden tallies at the belt. Hands and objects: the left hand held up with three fingers extended and the right thumb touching the third; the right hand rests on the wheel of a wooden sluice gate. Background: a big wooden wheel and iron chain at a stone sluice gate, a wall of grey stone holding back dark water, a few reeds and a pale grey sky over the water. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, flat and sad, showing a line of dampness on the stones. Expression: a weighted, cautious tenderness, the brows drawn and the mouth soft, an honest man carrying a secret about which village the water will take.

people.imagined: She sits as the second voice of the chronicle, stylus behind her ear, hair cropped like a grave-keeper's, listening for the evening that has been left out.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged and very upright, listening with her head cocked, a stylus behind her ear. Face (most important: very short cropped hair and a stylus tucked behind the ear): a plain, quiet, thoughtful face with strong cheekbones, steady dark eyes, a firm small mouth, a long neck, a straight nose. Her ears are small and bare, her skull has a neat shape under the cropped hair, and she has a faint scar across the left eyebrow. Hair: black, cropped close to the skull like a grave-keeper's, short enough to show the ear, a pale wooden stylus behind it. Body: thin, straight, still. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a grey-green sash, plain wide sleeves, small mud-brown stains at the hem. The robe is plain and slightly too large with small pale stains at the hem, and a small bag for the stylus lies by her knee. Hands and objects: both hands lie open on her knees; a small blank wooden tablet on the floor beside her. Background: a dim hall with pillars. Tall dark pillars rise behind her and a faint column of light falls from a high window onto the bare floor. Light: soft light from the upper left. The soft light picks out the stylus and the clean line of her neck. Expression: honest, cautious and reclusive.

people.imagined: Stopping on each stair with the ash-bowl pressed to her chest, breath short, never once allowed to light the stick.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stone stair, a covered bowl hugged to her chest in both arms, she looks at the viewer with a trusting, breathless smile, stopping on each step, never once allowed to light the stick. Face: a small, soft, round face with flushed cheeks, large brown eyes, a short nose, a gentle open mouth catching her breath, a smudge of grey ash on the forehead and a few wisps of hair stuck to the damp brow. Hair: black, in two small buns tied with green threads. Body: small and slim, bent slightly forward over the bowl, with ash on her fingertips. Clothing: a plain undyed pine-bark linen robe with the sleeves a little long and rolled twice, a plain cord belt, and a dusting of grey ash down the front from the bowl. Hands and objects: a round bronze bowl with a lid holding pale grey ash, hugged to the chest in both arms, a thin plume of ash drifting out under the lid. Background: a long stair of grey stone winding up between pines, an old stone lantern at each turn and a small bird on the rail. Light: soft, cool light from the upper left showing the thin plume of ash that escapes the lid. Expression: a trusting, humble, breathless smile, the eyes shining and the cheeks hot, a girl proud to be trusted with something precious and determined not to spill it.

people.imagined: He sits on the bench as if about to draw a sword; he has grown up on the story of the empty sleds and wants the Cold Ford.
people.subject: The moment: perched on the edge of a bench at dawn, one hand on a sword hilt, he leans forward and looks at the viewer with burning eyes, as if about to draw; he grew up on the story of the empty sleds and wants the Cold Ford. Face (most important: a drawn-sword posture, wrist on hilt, shoulders hunched forward like a spring): a sharp young face with a flat chin inherited from his father, bright fierce dark eyes, thick straight dark brows, a hard-set mouth, flushed cheeks, a stubborn jaw and a thin red line from a practice blade across the forearm. Hair: black, in a tight high tail with a green cord and a pine twig. Body: lean, hard and tense. Clothing: a tailored inner-disciple coat of undyed pine-bark linen with a needle-green sash and leather bracers with brass studs, boots polished bright. Hands and objects: the right hand gripping the hilt of a sheathed straight sword laid across his knee, thumb on the guard, a faded green cord wound round the scabbard in a neat spiral. Background: a dawn training ground with wooden swords standing in a rack against a low wall, pale grass in the yard and a hint of mist. Light: cold dawn light from the upper left that edges his profile and the steel of the hilt. Expression: a fierce, impatient eagerness, the mouth hard and the eyes bright, brave and warlike, a young man who has been waiting years to draw.

people.imagined: The dusk gong has sounded and she has startled and sat down on the step, white to the lips, still clutching the primer-slip.
people.subject: The moment: seated suddenly on a stone step after the dusk gong has sounded and startled her, one hand pressed to her chest and still clutching the primer slip, she looks up at the viewer with her face drained of colour. Face (most important: lips and face drained white): a thin, anxious, pale face with wide grey eyes, white lips, thin fair brows, pale lashes, a damp brow, a tiny pulse showing at the throat and a stubborn set to the jaw. Hair: black, in a long plait over one shoulder with a green ribbon and a pine twig. Body: slight and hunched with her knees drawn up. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with sleeves too long that hang past her wrists, a plain rope belt, a grey wool shawl with a soft fringe, and a small wooden practice token on a string. Hands and objects: the right hand on her breastbone, the left clutching a blank bamboo slip. Background: a lakeside stone step at dusk, cool and bare, the edge of a brass gong hanging from a post at the frame side and a faint mist over the lake beyond. Light: low dusk light from the upper left that turns her pale cheeks almost blue. Expression: startled but determined, the breath held and the jaw set, a cautious girl forcing herself to stay seated rather than run.

people.imagined: A young reindeer calf follows her to class and she will not send it home; she hugs its neck.
people.subject: The moment: standing with her arm round the neck of a young reindeer calf that followed her to class and that she will not send home, she grins at the viewer, scratching under its chin. Face (most important: a reindeer calf, big-eyed and brown-grey with small velvet antlers and a wet black nose, tucked against her): a round, windburnt, laughing face with bright black eyes, a snub nose, rosy cheeks, a small scar on the chin and a wide gap-toothed smile. Hair: black, in two long braids with leather ties and one white feather. Body: small and sturdy. Clothing: a heavy grey fur-trimmed coat closed with toggles of carved antler over an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a needle-green sash, and felt boots decorated with red stitching. Hands and objects: her left arm round the calf's neck and her right hand scratching under its chin; a small silver bell hangs from the calf's neck. Background: a pale classroom doorway with a bench inside framing a few startled students, blurred, and a stone threshold dusted with snow. Light: soft light from the upper left, making the calf's velvet antlers glow and highlighting her grin. Expression: a delighted, defiant grin, chin up and cheeks bright, brave and gregarious, a girl who does what she likes and expects everyone to like it too.

people.imagined: Asleep in the bow, curled on the ropes, one eye cracked open as the ferry touches the far bank; he wakes to say the head once rowed this boat.
people.subject: The moment: slumped asleep against the ferry's bow with his head on his arm, one eye just cracking open as the boat touches the far bank, he looks at the viewer, ready to wake and say the head once rowed this boat. Face: a round, peaceful, sleepy face with a slack mouth, a sleep crease across one cheek, a trace of drool, thick dark lashes, a snub nose and a patch of stubble just starting on the chin. Hair: black and sticking up. Body: loose, soft and sprawled comfortably. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket hanging open with no sash, trousers rolled unevenly, bare feet, and a straw hat pulled over one knee. Hands and objects: one arm under his head on a rolled mooring rope; a long worn bamboo pole lies beside him. Background: the prow of a wooden ferry in dark wood with a coil of mooring rope, pale river mist hanging low over the water. Light: soft morning light from the upper left, pale and warm on his sleeping face. Expression: lazy and sleepily content, the single open eye soft and unhurried and the mouth still slack, a generous, easy-going boy in no hurry to stop dreaming.

people.imagined: He measures a ward stone twice then a third time; a ruler tucked in his belt, wet to the knees from the sluice wash.
people.subject: The moment: crouching over a ward stone with a ruler laid against it, he looks up at the viewer to see whether the measure is right, having measured it twice and now a third time, wet to the knees from the sluice wash. Face: an earnest, thin, serious face with round dark eyes, a furrowed brow, a nervous half-smile, a pointed chin, damp hair stuck to the forehead and a shiny line of sweat on the upper lip. Hair: black, in a small topknot with a green cord, wet. Body: slim, careful and bent over, with narrow hands inked at the knuckles. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of undyed pine-bark linen soaked dark to the knees, a needle-green sash tied exactly, the sleeves tied back with two neat bands and a small plumb-bob dangling from the belt. Hands and objects: a wooden ruler with plain notches laid beside a flat grey stone; another ruler tucked in his belt and a third in his sleeve. Background: a wall of wet grey stone and a plank walkway over foaming wash, with a few rulers floating in a bucket. Light: bright grey light from the upper left that makes the water sparkle and darkens the wet cloth. Expression: a cautious, humble diligence, the brow knitted and the half-smile hesitant, a conscientious young man who is afraid the measure is wrong and will check it again.

people.imagined: Always chewing something from the basket she is supposed to deliver; she holds a pale fungus slab and says the trunk was bare.
people.subject: The moment: caught with her mouth full, she holds half a pale fungus in her hand and smiles guiltily at the viewer, always chewing something from the basket she is supposed to deliver, ready to swear the trunk was bare. Face (most important: a bulging cheek, mouth full, a crumb on the lip): a round, rosy, laughing face with full cheeks, one cheek bulging, bright dark eyes, a dimple, round brows, a soft neck, a crumb of pale flesh on the lower lip and chin and a greasy sheen at the lips. Hair: black, in a loose bun with a pine twig and a wisp over one eye. Body: plump and comfortable. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with the sleeves rolled and tied above the elbows, a green apron whose pocket bulges with stolen fungus, a green ribbon at the waist and a bundle of reed baskets on her back. Hands and objects: a bite-marked slab of pale poria fungus in the right hand; the left holds a woven basket of more slabs. Background: a dark forest floor strewn with fallen trunks furred with moss and bracket fungus, a few grey birds on a log. Light: dappled light from the upper left moving over her cheek and the pale flesh of the fungus. Expression: an unrepentant, guilty grin with the cheek still full, the eyes bright and the brows raised, a sociable girl who finds her own greed funny and expects you to as well.

people.imagined: She sniffs her sleeves before she speaks; the first to say the new resin smells thin, and the one the blame has landed on.
people.subject: The moment: she lifts her own sleeve to her nose and sniffs it, looking over the cuff at the viewer, the first to say the new resin smells thin and the one the blame has landed on. Face: a quiet, pale, slender face with a long straight nose lifted slightly, half-closed grey-green eyes with long lashes, a thin mouth, a tiny scar on the upper lip, a few strands of hair over the cheek and a speck of resin on the chin. Hair: black, in a loose low knot flecked with resin. Body: slim and a little slumped. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a needle-green sash and a bone-handled chisel tucked in it, the sleeves stained golden with sticky resin up to the elbow, and an apron stiff with dried resin flecks. Hands and objects: the right sleeve at her nose; the left holds a small chisel and a split piece of amber resin, the fingertips stained amber and sticky. Background: a long bench stacked with split lumps of resin, a few pots of pitch and a low oil lamp. Light: soft golden light from the upper left that makes her cheek look like amber. Expression: a patient, unhurried, withdrawn look, the eyes half closed in concentration and the thin mouth set, the quiet detachment of a woman who trusts her nose over every opinion in the room.

people.imagined: Spoiling for a fight and disappointed that no one has come; he leans on the fence glaring at the empty hill.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a fence rail, he looks at the viewer with a scowl and a chin jutted forward, as if hoping for an insult, spoiling for a fight and disappointed that no one has come. Face: a square, hard, handsome face with a crooked, once-broken nose, thick brows, dark hungry eyes that glint, a pugnacious jaw, a split lip healing and a vein standing out at the temple. Hair: black, cropped, with a pine twig. Body: broad-shouldered, muscular and restless. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket with the sleeves cut off cleanly at the shoulder, a needle-green sash, leather bracers, and a plain iron-bound belt with a scuffed buckle above polished-down boots. Hands and objects: the knuckles of the right fist scarred; the left hand drumming on the fence rail; a short wooden staff leaning beside him. Background: an empty grey hillside with a long rail of fence curving to the horizon and a single pine in the distance. Light: hard light from the upper left that makes his scarred knuckles look white. Expression: a bored, belligerent scowl, the lip curled and the eyes searching the empty hill for someone to hit, stubborn and arrogant, restless for want of an opponent.

people.imagined: Dice rattle in his pocket at every step; he is shaking a pair in his fist, grinning before the throw.
people.subject: The moment: he rattles a pair of dice in a closed fist near his ear and grins at the viewer, ready to throw, dice rattling in the pocket at every step. Face: a cheerful, honest, round-cheeked face with bright brown eyes, thick lashes, short thick eyebrows, a wide grin with a gap between the front teeth, a smear of grey dust and soot on the forehead and cheeks, and a tiny bone stud in one ear. Hair: dark brown, cropped and sticking out. Body: stocky and solid. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket stained grey at the cuffs with no sash, a greasy leather miner's cap pushed back on his head, and a heavy pocket dragging down one side with a few small green stones in the other. Hands and objects: the right fist raised with two small white bone dice showing between the fingers; the left pocket bulging. Background: the rough dark opening of a mine framed in grey timber, with a lantern on a hook swaying slightly. Light: yellow lantern light from the lower left on his raised fist and the dice, mixing with daylight from the upper left. Expression: a boy's hopeful, open grin, the eyes bright and fixed on the fist, honest and easy, entirely certain that this throw will be a good one.

people.imagined: Counting sacks under his breath faster than his father, a pencil stub behind each ear.
people.subject: The moment: counting on his fingers with his lips moving, eyes sliding to the viewer. Face (most important: a short pencil stub tucked behind each ear): a lean, quick, sly face with a long upper lip, narrow bright eyes, a pointed chin, a pencil stub behind the left ear and another behind the right. His nose is long, his lips are thin, and the stub of a pencil behind each ear tilts in opposite directions. Hair: black, plastered flat with oil. Body: thin and fidgety. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket with grain dust, a needle-green sash, a leather pouch of copper at his belt, clean cuffs. A leather purse hangs from a cord at his belt and the sash is neat, with a coin string looped in his pocket. Hands and objects: five fingers of the left hand held up in a count; the right hand pointing at a stack of sacks. Background: stacked grain sacks, a granary door. Grain sacks rise in tidy stacks to the roof and a wooden door stands ajar, with a ledger board hung on a nail. Light: dusty light from the upper left. The dusty light makes his oiled hair shine. Expression: pragmatic, lazy and gregarious; counting faster than he should.

people.imagined: Back from a road with windburnt cheeks and a plum tassel on his satchel; he has been drinking with boatmen and he smiles at a messenger's duties.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a satchel in hand, he smiles at the viewer with a windburnt, confident look, back from the road with a plum tassel on the bag, having drunk with boatmen, about to deliver his answer whenever he feels like it. Face (most important: a dark plum-red silk tassel hanging from the satchel, big in the frame, and windburnt cheeks): a handsome, ruddy face with bright dark eyes that crease with easy laughter, a confident grin, a short brown beard, and a sunburnt nose peeling from the wind. Hair: black, windblown, in a high tail with a green cord. Body: tall and easy-limbed. Clothing: an inner-disciple riding coat of undyed pine-bark linen with a needle-green sash, riding boots, riding gloves tucked in the belt and a small wine gourd on a red cord. Hands and objects: the leather satchel held up on the right hand, the fine plum silk tassel swinging; the wine gourd at his belt. Background: boats with square sails moored along a pebbled shore and a river road running along a low embankment. Light: bright light from the upper left giving a sheen to his windburnt cheeks and to the swinging tassel. Expression: a confident, easygoing grin, the eyes creased and the head tilted a little back, sociable and a little arbitrary, an ambitious messenger who knows his answer is worth waiting for.

people.imagined: Cocks his head toward the hill while others speak; he swears he hears only the wind.
people.subject: The moment: standing among others, he turns his head sharply to listen to a hill, then glances at the viewer, innocent, swearing he hears only the wind. Face (most important: the head cocked sharply to one side, ear toward the hill): a plain, narrow, careful face with wary dark eyes, a thin mouth, a freckled nose, one eyebrow raised, large ears, a faint blush of fear on the cheeks and a pine needle caught in the hair. Hair: black and uneven, with a pine twig stuck crookedly in it. Body: slim, stringy and tense. Clothing: a clean undyed pine-bark linen robe with a plain rope belt and sap stains at the sleeves, the hem tied up out of the way with a strip of cloth, and a woodcutter's small hatchet in a leather sheath stitched crookedly at his belt. Hands and objects: one hand lifted behind the ear as if cupping it; the other holds a pine nut. Background: a dim hill that is a dark mass of pines with a faint path winding up it, a small moon rising above it at dusk. Light: dim dusk light from the upper left that hides half his face and leaves the pine nut bright in his hand. Expression: a shifty innocence, the eyes wide and the mouth too straight, a loyal, cautious boy who has learned that the safest answer is that he heard nothing.

people.imagined: She walks murmuring the roll under her breath, her thin straight nose lifted, her knees still sore from the pine cones.
people.subject: The moment: walking, her lips moving silently as she recites the roll under her breath, eyes straight ahead and then flicking to the viewer, her knees still sore from kneeling on pine cones. Face (most important: a thin straight nose, the clan's, and moving lips): a pale, narrow, proud face with a long thin straight nose, narrow dark eyes, a firm mouth shaping words and a tiny line of effort between the brows. Hair: black, in a tight high bun with two wooden pins. Body: slim, upright and stiff. Clothing: a neat and exact undyed pine-bark linen robe with small pine-resin stains on the knees, a plain cord belt tied with a slim knot and a small bamboo slip hung at the hip. Hands and objects: both hands clasped behind her back; a bamboo slip clipped at the belt. Background: a stone corridor lined with long pale pillars, a faint reflection of the floor shining on the walls and a lamp at the far end. Light: clean, cool light from the upper left that gives her face a waxen look. Expression: an exact, recitation face, the lips shaping each syllable and the eyes cold with ambition, a diligent girl whose memory is her weapon and who has not forgotten a slight.

people.imagined: She raises two fingers to her lips to blow a two-note whistle so a whole field looks up; she waves signal flags along the sluices.
people.subject: The moment: two fingers at her lips, cheeks puffed in a sharp whistle, eyes bright on the viewer, a signal flag in the other hand. Face: a strong, open, sunburnt face, bright hazel eyes, thick brows, a wide mouth puckered, freckles, a stray curl. Her cheeks are rosy and her lips are pursed, with a faint line of dirt on her chin and a stray curl at her temple. Hair: brown, in a loose braid tied with a green cord, a pine twig. Body: lithe and sturdy. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket with a needle-green sash, rolled trousers, bare feet in wet mud. The jacket's sleeves are rolled and mud splatters the trouser legs, with a bundle of spare flags tied at her back. Hands and objects (the flag is the lead): a bright plain green signal flag on a short pole in the left hand, raised; two fingers of the right hand at the lips. Background: lowland fields and a sluice line under a wide sky. A green lowland of flat fields and long ditches stretches to a low line of trees, with a line of white birds in flight. Light: bright light from the upper left. The bright sun makes the green flag glow and warms her freckles. Expression: brave, honest and compassionate.

people.imagined: One eyebrow lifts by itself when she listens; she can chant the primer backwards and has been told to stop.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling and listening with her head tilted, her left eyebrow raised high on its own, she looks at the viewer with gentle curiosity; she can chant the primer backwards and has been told to stop. Face (most important: a single eyebrow arched high, the other level): a soft, mild, round face with a high arched left brow, a level right brow, calm attentive brown eyes, a small gentle closed mouth and a faint dimple that appears when she listens. Hair: black, in a long single braid with a green ribbon. Body: slim and quiet, kneeling with an easy straight back. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of undyed pine-bark linen with a needle-green sash tied in a bow with neat ends, the sleeves wide and soft, her hands drawn into them. Hands and objects: both hands folded in her lap; a small wooden clapper rests beside her knee. Background: a quiet hall of pale pillars and soft shadows, with a thin beam of light falling on a floor mat beside her. Light: soft, even light from the upper left that rests quietly on her face and the raised brow. Expression: a mild, devout attention, the head tilted and the left brow lifting by itself, humble and patient, the look of a girl who hears more than she says and does not know it is unusual.

people.imagined: Head cook at the stove with a ladle pointed like a sword at the person who asked twice; she has cooked without an open flame for sixty years.
people.subject: The moment: standing behind a big pot, she levels a long ladle like a sword at the viewer with a firm, half-amused glare. Face (most important: a ladle pointed at the viewer, large and in the foreground): a broad, red-cheeked, strong-featured old face with deep laugh lines, small shrewd black eyes, a big nose, a stern but generous mouth, a double chin, a floury cheek. Her arms are thick and floury to the elbow, her jaw is square, and her laugh lines turn deep when she scowls. Hair: grey, tied up in a white cloth. Body: stout, wide, formidable. Clothing: a servant's tunic of undyed linen with a big clean white apron, sleeves rolled to the elbow, forearms thick and floury; no sash. The apron has a long smear of sauce and the white cloth on her head is knotted tight, with a ring of keys at the belt. Hands and objects: a long iron ladle held out in front like a sword; a steaming black pot behind her. Background: a kitchen with hanging pans, steam, no open flame, only glowing coals in a covered stove. Pots and pans of every size hang from the wall, and a big covered stove glows red at the corner, with steam rising to the beams. Light: warm light from the upper left. The warm light and steam make her face shine and put a gleam on the ladle. Expression: generous, arbitrary and honest; commanding.

people.imagined: Warp-strings knotted round both wrists, she sits at the loom and knows every robe by its sleeve; a second bolt is quietly hidden.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a loom, she looks up at the viewer with a guarded face, strings looped round both wrists. Face: a narrow, withdrawn, lined face with sharp dark eyes, a thin mouth, a crease between the brows, pale skin, a fleck of lint on the cheek. Her fingers are thin and rough, the skin of her wrists is marked by the strings, and lines of lint cover her sleeves. Hair: grey-black, in a tight bun under a plain cloth. Body: spare, bent shoulders. Clothing: a servant's tunic of coarse undyed linen, clean, with a brown apron, sleeves rolled, bare forearms. The apron is brown linen with a row of pins in the bib and her sleeves are short, with a bobbin on a cord round her neck. Hands and objects (the strings are the lead): thick bands of knotted warp-strings wound round both wrists like bracelets, trailing; a shuttle in one hand; behind her a loom with pale bark-linen cloth half-woven. Background: a weaving room with bolts of pale cloth piled. A tall loom with half-woven cloth fills the left side, and shelves of bobbins and thread are piled up behind her. Light: soft light from a window at the upper left. The pale window light shows the fine threads in the air. Expression: diligent, reclusive and greedy; guarded.

people.imagined: Bark flakes fall from his beard as he nods, driving his cart a day out of the way to avoid a fresh stump.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a cart bench holding the reins, he nods slowly to the viewer while bark flakes fall from his beard, having driven a day out of the way to avoid a fresh stump. Face (most important: a thick bushy grey-brown beard full of tiny bark flakes and sawdust): a broad, weathered, calm face with a heavy brow, small deep-set eyes, a big flat nose, thick ears, a very full grey-brown beard flecked with bark, and bark flakes lying in the lines of the brow. Hair: grey, short and thick, under a tight cloth cap. Body: thick, strong and slow, broad shoulders with bark on them. Clothing: a servant's tunic of coarse brown wool over a vest of cracked leather, the sleeves rolled, a rope belt and heavy mud-caked boots; there is no sash, being a mortal servant and not a disciple; a leather strap round the wrist holds the reins. Hands and objects: reins in both hands; behind him a heavy fallen log lashed on the cart. Background: a forest track running between tall trees, fallen trunks furred with moss beside it and a patient ox standing in the traces. Light: soft light from the upper left, calm, showing the pale bark chips falling. Expression: a calm, slow, stubborn gravity, the eyes steady and the mouth hidden in the beard, a devout man who will go any distance rather than harm a tree.

people.imagined: Surfacing from a pearl dive, she holds up her wrinkled fingertips and a bag, smiling like someone who has already got away with it.
people.subject: The moment: just surfaced from the water, hair streaming, holding up a small net bag and her free hand with pruned fingertips, smiling at the viewer. Face (most important: wrinkled, pruned fingertips on the raised hand, spread wide): a bright, clever, wet face with strong cheekbones, sharp dark eyes, thin level brows, a quick sly smile, water running from the chin. Her lips are pale blue from the cold water, her lashes are spiky with drops, and a small gap between her front teeth shows when she smiles. Hair: black and wet, plastered to the head and neck. Body: lithe, strong shoulders, wet. Clothing: a thin undyed pine-bark linen jerkin clinging wet, a needle-green sash tied round the waist, bare arms. The jerkin is thin and dark with water and the sash is wound twice and knotted, with a small knife on a cord at her hip. Hands and objects: the right hand raised with fingers visibly shrivelled and wrinkled white; the left holds a small dripping net bag with a few pale pearls showing. Background: a lake surface with ripples and a small boat edge. Small boats float on the green water with other divers in the shallows, blurred, and a few bubbles rise near her. Light: bright light from the upper left, glinting on water. The bright light dazzles on the water and shines on the wet strands of her hair. Expression: brave, deceitful and ambitious.

people.imagined: He rolls along like a man always crossing ice, jaw working over something hidden under his tongue.
people.subject: The moment: he walks with a wide, rolling, careful gait, looking at the viewer from the side with one cheek slightly bulged, like a man always crossing ice, jaw working over something hidden under his tongue. Face (most important: a bulge in the cheek and a rolling wide-legged gait): a heavy-jawed, wind-reddened, stubborn face with small deceptive eyes, thick brows with a little white scar through the left one, a flat nose from an old break, thick tight lips pressed shut over something hidden, and red cheeks. Hair: black, in a short rough cut. Body: stocky and thick-legged, balancing with his arms held out as if on ice. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket over a thick grey wool shirt, no sash, iron-spiked ice-cleats bound with leather over his boots and a thick scarf wound round his neck. Hands and objects: both arms slightly out to the sides for balance; an ice-hook hanging from the belt. Background: a frozen lake stretching into white haze with a few black holes cut in the ice and a sled leaning on a post. Light: cold light from the upper left leaving his red cheeks glowing, his breath hanging in a small cloud. Expression: a shut, stubborn, sideways look, the lips tight and the cheek bulging, impatient and shifty, pleased with a secret kept in his mouth.

people.imagined: Fletching feathers stuck in his belt like a tail; he says aloud what the Root Hall says in private.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a bow over his shoulder and his chin raised, he speaks boldly to the viewer, saying aloud what the Root Hall says only in private. Face: a handsome, haughty, square-jawed face with bold dark eyes, strong brows, a thin moustache, a proud mouth, a straight thin nose, white teeth, a small scar on the chin and a tiny gold stud in the left ear. Hair: black, in a high tail with a green cord and a pine twig. Body: tall, broad-shouldered and upright. Clothing (the feathers are the lead): a tailored inner-disciple coat of undyed pine-bark linen with a needle-green sash, and in his belt a fan of nine long grey fletching feathers sticking out behind like a bird's tail; bracers carved with a bow pattern and a fine quiver of dyed red leather. Hands and objects: a long bow wrapped at the grip with green cord, held in the left hand with its tip on the ground; the right thumb hooked in the belt. Background: an archery field with straw targets standing at the end of a long field, a rack of bows leaning against a wall and a pale sky. Light: bright light from the upper left shining on the feathers and giving his hair a blue-black gloss. Expression: a bold, arrogant half-smile, the chin high and the eyes challenging, warlike and brave, a man who enjoys being the first to say the thing others dare not.

people.imagined: On the dike at dusk he sings his father's name under his breath; he has his father's cleft chin and uses it when he is about to say nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a dike at dusk, mouth closed, chin set and cleft, looking calmly at the viewer. Face (most important: a deep cleft in the chin, clear at the centre): a long, calm, severe face with a deep dimple-like cleft chin, dark steady eyes, level brows, a firm closed mouth, a pale line scar on the jaw. His brows are level, his lips are firm, and a faint line runs from nose to mouth, with a stubble shadow on the jaw. Hair: black, in a plain knot with a green cord. Body: tall, lean, quiet. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of undyed pine-bark linen with a needle-green sash, damp at the hem, a river-brown cloak. The cloak is of dull river-brown wool pinned with a plain bone pin and the boots are dark with dike mud, with a tally cord on the belt. Hands and objects: arms folded; a flood-mark chalk in one hand. Background: a dike at dusk, a pale river and low light. A stone dike runs away to a dusk-pink horizon and a few reeds bend by the water, with a small boat moored. Light: gold dusk light from the upper left. The low gold light lights half his face and leaves the cleft in his chin a deep shadow. Expression: calm, vengeful and patient; silent.

people.imagined: A market girl with a copper on a string at her neck, delivering sealed letters, trusting and smiling.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bright market, she holds a sealed letter in each hand and smiles trustingly at the viewer. Face (most important: a single copper coin with a square hole hung on a string at her throat): a round, friendly, rosy face with big brown eyes, a snub nose, a wide cheerful mouth, a small mole at the corner of the lip. Her eyes are big and brown, her teeth are small and white, and a few freckles scatter across her nose. Hair: black, in two braids looped with green thread. Body: sturdy, small, brisk. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, plain rope belt, a market apron; round her neck a square-holed copper coin on a thin red string. The apron is of blue market cloth and her satchel strap is red, with a small bell sewn onto the strap. Hands and objects: two letters folded and sealed with plain wax discs held in the right hand; a satchel on the left shoulder. Background: bright market awnings, baskets and stalls. Stalls with bright cloth, baskets of pears, and strings of dried fish line the lane behind her, with a donkey at the edge. Light: bright light from the upper left. The warm sunlight turns the copper coin into a spot of gold at her throat. Expression: trusting, gregarious and loyal.

people.imagined: A fresh bruise on his cheek like a medal; he has just cracked a rival's ribs after the bout and calls it manners.
people.subject: The moment: he stands with a chest out and a chin high, a swollen purple bruise on one cheek, looking down his nose at the viewer. Face (most important: a big fresh purple-yellow bruise on the left cheek, worn proudly): a young sharp face with a thin proud nose, narrow bright eyes, a thin smile with a hint of cruelty, thick black brows, a swollen cheekbone in purple and yellow, a split in the lip. His lip is split and swollen, his jaw is narrow, and he has a gleam of pride in his small dark eyes. Hair: black, in a high tail with a green cord. Body: lean, small for his arrogance, stiff-backed. Clothing: an outer-disciple robe of undyed pine-bark linen, clean, no sash, wooden practice-guard on one forearm. The practice guard on his forearm is of bamboo bound with cord and the robe is clean and creased as if freshly pressed, with plain cloth shoes. Hands and objects: knuckles skinned on the right fist, held at his side. Background: a bright practice yard. A packed-earth yard with a wooden post wrapped in straw stands behind him, and a few older disciples watch from a veranda, blurred. Light: hard morning light from the upper left. The hard light makes the bruise stand out in violet and yellow. Expression: arrogant, ambitious and cruel.

people.imagined: At the chimney furnace she stokes the fire, one eye red from smoke, eyebrows burnt to stubble, wanting the second furnace.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at a furnace mouth with a poker, she looks over her shoulder at the viewer with a hard ambitious stare. Face (most important: one red, swollen smoke-irritated eye, and eyebrows burnt to short stubble): a thin, sharp, sooty face, one eye reddened and weeping, the other black and keen, eyebrows singed to short bristles, a tight mouth, ash on the nose. Her lashes are singed short, her lips are tight and dry, and her good eye is fierce and bright. Hair: black, tied in a high tail, the ends singed. Body: wiry, strong forearms. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of undyed pine-bark linen smudged with soot, a needle-green sash, a thick leather apron, sleeves tied up. The apron is black with scorches and her sleeves are tied with wet cloth bands, with a leather glove on the left hand. Hands and objects: an iron poker in her right hand, glowing orange at the tip; the left shielding her eyes. Background: a furnace mouth with glowing coals, a black chimney. A brick furnace mouth gapes behind her and a tall pipe climbs into smoke, with a line of clay jars on a shelf. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower right. The orange glow dances on the poker and on her sweaty forehead. Expression: ambitious, diligent and callous.

people.imagined: He props a plank against his hip and sits to carve it; he cannot lift it. Another takes the credit and he does not mind.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a low stool with a plank propped against his hip, carving with a small knife, looking up at the viewer with a quiet smile. Face: a thin, gentle, pale face with a narrow chin, soft dark eyes, a shy mouth, a freckle cluster on the nose, fine sawdust on his cheek. His fingers are long and scarred with small knife cuts, and his eyes are mild and tired, with a smear of sawdust in his hair. Hair: brown, in a small knot with a pine twig. Body: slight, narrow, weak in the shoulders. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, plain, no sash, a leather apron, sleeves rolled over thin forearms. The apron has a row of tiny pockets and his sleeves are rolled above thin elbows, with a small wooden mallet at his belt. Hands and objects: a long pale plank leaning against his hip and held with one arm; the other hand carving a leaf pattern with a small knife. Background: a workshop with beams and shavings. Stacked planks lean on a wall and a pile of pale shavings lies on the floor, with a half-carved bird on a bench. Light: soft light from the upper left. The soft light shows the fine grain of the plank and the curl of a shaving. Expression: diligent, humble and peaceable.

people.imagined: On the road with mud to the knees and a bruise on his hip from the satchel, he opens the satchel at an inn and grins.
people.subject: The moment: seated on an inn step with the satchel open on his knees, he peeks at a sealed letter and looks up at the viewer with a quick fickle grin, in from the road with mud to the knees and a bruise on his hip from the satchel. Face: a sunburnt, lively, boyish face with bright quick eyes, messy brows, a wide grin with crooked teeth and a gap, a small scar on the nose and a scrap of straw stuck in the tousled hair. Hair: brown and tousled with a pine twig. Body: lean and loose-limbed, sprawled on the step. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket over trousers rolled and mud-caked to the knee, a needle-green sash askew and travel-scuffed boots; the leather satchel has a scuffed corner and has worn a bruise-coloured mark on the cloth of his hip. Hands and objects: the leather satchel open on his knee with a folded sealed letter half out; the other hand at the strap. Background: an inn courtyard with a trough and a tethered horse and a brown dog watching the satchel. Light: lazy gold afternoon light from the upper left that gleams on the folded letter. Expression: a quick, fickle grin, the eyes darting to the letter and back to you, sociable and shameless, a messenger who treats every secret as a small entertainment.

people.imagined: He arrives in time for nothing; he has missed three ferries and a wedding. He sits with the scales on his knee and lends money kindly.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a weighing scale, he smiles with kindly resignation at the viewer, one hand lifted in apology. Face: a large, soft, bald-crowned, good-natured face with a double chin, half-moon eyes, thick grey brows, a small round nose, a gentle smile, an old man's pink cheeks. His hands are soft and ink-stained, his ears are large, and a trace of resin shines on his forefinger. Hair: sparse white hair at the sides, bald on top. Body: heavy, comfortable, a slow sitter. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, well worn and washed soft, no sash, a leather weighing apron, sleeves with chalk marks. The robe is faded to cream and the apron's strings are tied in a loose bow, with a small wooden abacus hung from the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand raised in a slow apologetic wave; the left rests on a large iron beam scale holding a lump of amber resin on one pan. Background: a resin warehouse with barrels. Rows of barrels stand in a high warehouse with ladders and ropes, and a little cart with a broken axle sits in the corner. Light: warm light from the upper left. The warm light is golden and settles kindly on his round face. Expression: content, patient and generous.

people.imagined: On the north-shore cliffs he keeps a rolled-bark spyglass to his eye, counting skiffs; he never looks at anyone close by.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a cliff edge with a rolled bark spyglass held to one eye, the other eye wide, he glances at the viewer once, counting skiffs and never looking at anyone close by. Face (most important: a spyglass of rolled pale birch bark raised to the left eye, long and plain): a narrow, pale, tense face with a sharp nose, thin chapped lips, a worried crease, wind-reddened eyes and a faint ring pressed round the eye by the tube, one wide wary eye showing. Hair: black, tied back with a cord and blown loose by the wind. Body: thin, sharp-shouldered and rigid. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jacket with a needle-green cord at the waist, a heavy wool cloak against the wind clasped with a bone pin, boots laced to the knee and a small leather case on the belt; a cord round the neck carries the spyglass when not in use. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the rolled bark tube to the eye; the left grips a cliff rock. Background: a high cliff dropping sheer to a grey lake with tiny boats on it and clouds trailing across a pale sky. Light: cold windy light from the upper left that strips colour from everything except his red hands. Expression: a tight, wary, suspicious attention, the one visible eye wide and the mouth clamped, a loyal, solitary watcher who trusts distance more than people.

people.imagined: Dawn at the retreat. She stands straight and small, grey-green sash stirring though no wind blows, the wolf's tooth on its cord at her chest; she is listening to the pines for the fifteenth layer.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a stone step she stands small and straight, head slightly tilted, listening, and then turns her calm eyes to the viewer. Face (most important: a sash of grey-green silk lifting and stirring in still air, and a single wolf's tooth on a cord): a small, fine-boned old face, finely lined, cheeks soft, level pale grey eyes full of stillness, thin white brows, a mouth with a faint smile; skin pale and clear. Hair: pure white, cut at the jaw in a straight line, no ornament save a single pine twig. Body: small, upright, light as a reed, a straight back. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe of the finest weave, with a wide grey-green silk sash tied loosely at the waist, its ends lifting sideways as if moved by a breeze; a long unadorned outer sleeve. Hands and objects: both hands folded; at the chest on a thin cord a single curved yellowed wolf's tooth the length of a finger. Background: tall dark pines and pale dawn mist, perfectly still. Light: soft gold dawn light from the upper left. Expression: calm, just and devout; gently listening. A faint wood-green hint in the air near her.

people.imagined: He stands at the riverbank with his head tilted as if hearing a sound behind him, wearing the undyed bark robe of the listening; ferryman's hands at rest.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a river, head tilted slightly to one side as if listening to something behind him, he looks at the viewer. Face (most important: the head tilted before speech, and big ferryman's hands): a long, gentle, deeply lined face, a long nose, calm dark eyes, thick grey brows, a kind mouth, a short grey beard; weathered brown skin with a slight sunburn. His eyes are deep-set and kind with fine lines like river ripples, his ears are long, and a faint tan line marks the neck. Hair: grey, in a long plain tail tied with a grey-green cord, a single pine twig. Body: tall, stooped, long-limbed, broad-handed. Clothing: the undyed pine-bark linen robe of the listening, soft and plain, with wide sleeves, a plain narrow sash, no ornament at all. The robe is plain undyed bark linen worn soft at the cuffs and mended at the hem, and the narrow sash has been rewoven in two places, with plain cord sandals. Hands and objects: two huge calloused ferryman's hands hanging open at his sides, thick-knuckled and brown; behind him a coiled mooring rope on a post. Background: a broad river at dusk, small boats, pines on the far bank. The river is wide and calm and a few ferries with square sails cross the water in the distance, with a low village on the far bank and smoke rising straight. Light: soft gold light from the upper left. The gold evening light rests on his grey hair and the hands, and the water behind him glitters softly. Expression: calm, humble and generous. A faint hint of wind-green qi around the sleeves.

people.imagined: He walks the quay like a fisher on a wet deck, a seal of green stone hanging at his belt where a sword would. He wants the Cold Ford back.
people.subject: The moment: standing with feet planted wide as if on a wet deck, a thumb hooked in his belt beside a green stone seal, looking at the viewer with stubborn authority. Face (most important: a green stone seal hung at the belt, the size of a fist, and a broad weathered fisher's face): a broad, weathered, square face, deep wind-lines, a heavy nose, small hard black eyes, thick grey brows, a firm square jaw, a grey beard cropped short. His hands are broad with thick knuckles, scarred by hooks and nets, and his neck is short and strong with deep sun-lines. Hair: grey, cropped short with a bare plain knot. Body: wide, heavy, planted, a rolling walk. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen coat with a heavy grey-green sash since he is an elder, a leather collar, sleeves with bracers. The coat has a leather collar worn pale and the seal's cord is of thick braided hemp dyed green, with heavy fisher's boots, oiled. Hands and objects: a thick, plain green jade seal the size of a fist hung by a cord from the belt where a sword would be; one hand rests on it. Background: a harbour quay of wet stones and moored boats in grey light. Wet stone steps lead down to the water and a row of tarred boats with furled brown sails is moored along the quay, with gulls. Light: grey light from the upper left. The cold grey light is flat and makes the wet stones shine like pewter. Expression: stubborn, loyal and warlike; a grim steady face.

people.imagined: At noon she carries the abbey's green glass lamp, lit, because she has never been without it since the flood. River mud dries on her hem.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a dike at noon with a lit green glass lamp held at her hip, she looks quietly at the viewer, never having been without the abbey's lamp since the flood, river mud drying on her hem. Face (most important: a small green glass lamp, lit and glowing, in the middle of the day): a thin, composed, pale face with a long fine nose, patient pale-grey eyes, a firm small mouth, fine lines at the corners of the eyes and a still gaze. Hair: black, in a plain low knot with a grey-green cord and a plain wooden comb. Body: thin, straight and narrow-shouldered, with long thin fingers and a trace of dried river mud at the wrist. Clothing: a long robe of dark blue cloth with an undyed bark-linen collar and narrow sleeves, a grey-green sash with a small bag of lamp oil at the belt, the hem stiff with dried river mud to the knee. Hands and objects: a small old lamp of green glass with a brass cap, lit with a steady pale flame, held in the right hand by its ring; the left hand rests on a stone dike post. Background: a dike with posts painted in ringed flood-marks, a wide river with a flat boat drifting on it and a few white birds low over the water. Light: pale noon light from the upper left, with the lamp tinting her fingers and the shadow under her chin a faint green. Expression: a patient, practical, withdrawn stillness, the gaze steady and the mouth quiet, a woman who carries a small light through broad day because she once needed it.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Voices she laughs before she answers, tapping a teaching fan against her palm, remembering exactly what you told her forty years ago.
people.subject: The moment: mid-laugh in the Hall of Voices, she taps a closed fan against her palm and nods at the viewer in a knowing way, recalling exactly what you told her forty years ago. Face (most important: a laughing mouth and bright round plump cheeks): a plump, round, rosy, quick face with a big laugh, bright black eyes crinkling into half-moons, arched brows, a double chin and deep laugh lines, with no pretence in it. Hair: black and grey, in a high round bun held by a long pine-wood pin, a few loose curls. Body: plump, short and quick, with small quick hands, the fingers plump with a ring of jade. Clothing: a robe of grey-green silk-linen with a high collar and wide sleeves lined with pale blue silk, a sash of deeper green, a string of small white lake pearls knotted in threes at her chest and embroidered grey-green shoes. Hands and objects: a closed teaching fan of pale bamboo tapping the left palm; a small pearl pin in her hair. Background: a bright hall of tall pale pillars with rows of cross-legged students in undyed robes, blurred, and a lacquered stand holding a gong. Light: warm light from the upper left brightening her round cheeks, the pearls glowing softly. Expression: a warm, sharp, forgiving laugh, the eyes bright and shrewd and the whole face sociable, a teacher who forgives everything and remembers it all.

people.imagined: On her way back from a search by the Root Hall, whole, she hides the ink-stained side of her right hand in her sleeve; the zither is on her back. She wants to be worthy.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a stair with a zither on her back, her right hand drawn back into the sleeve, she looks at the viewer with determined gentleness, back from a search by the Root Hall, whole, and hiding the ink-stained side of her hand because she wants to be worthy. Face (most important: a seven-string zither in a plain cloth case rising behind her shoulder, and the ink-stained hand tucked into the sleeve): a slight, fine-featured young face with a high forehead, serious dark eyes with a faint shadow of tiredness under them, level brows, a small firm mouth and a long neck. Hair: black, in a smooth high knot with two pine twigs and a green cord. Body: slight, upright and narrow-shouldered, with a wide strap across the chest. Clothing: a fine undyed pine-bark linen robe with long narrow sleeves and a needle-green sash, a thin line of ink-black showing at the right cuff, and a zither case of plain grey cloth stitched with a pine-needle pattern. Hands and objects: the right hand hidden in the left sleeve while the left hand, slender, bare and clean, rests against the strap; the pegs of the zither show above her shoulder. Background: a long stone stair rising between tall pines to a pale gate at the top standing in mist, with a few small birds on the rail. Light: soft light from the upper left falling on her high forehead and the pegs of the zither. Qi: a faint wood-green hint near her. Expression: a stubborn, gentle diligence, the mouth soft and the eyes level, a compassionate young woman determined to deserve her place.

people.imagined: He sits very still, counting under his breath, blue-stained fingers on his knee, a small bundle of rolled flags beside him; he wants them never to be unrolled.
people.subject: The moment: sitting rigidly still with his lips moving in a silent count, he turns only his eyes to the viewer. Face (most important: frost-white eyebrows, thick and long, over pale eyes, and blue-stained fingers): a long-boned, gaunt old face with high cheekbones, a long nose, thick eyebrows white as frost, pale grey eyes, a thin lipless mouth, deep lines; the skin sallow. His hands are long and bony with blue-stained fingers, his ears are long, and fine white hairs fringe his brow. Hair: thin white hair tied in a tight bun, a pine twig. Body: tall, bony, extremely still. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe, with a grey-green elder's sash, high collar, sleeves ending in tight cuffs. The collar is high and stiff, and the sleeves are rolled tight at the cuffs and bound with cord, with a bundle of small flags beside his knee, with plain shoes. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the knee, its fingers stained blue to the second knuckle; beside him, on the floor, a tight roll of small cloth flags bound with a cord. Background: a bare hall with chalk lines drawn on the floor. Chalk lines of an enormous array cross the floor in circles and spokes, and tall bare walls rise behind, with a single barred window. Light: cold light from the upper left. The cold light shows each chalk line sharply and leaves his face pale as paper. Expression: diligent, stubborn and callous; unmoving. A faint pale-blue hint of cold around him.

people.imagined: At dawn on the north shore she counts the skiffs across the water with a bronze mirror at her hip, wind in her face.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a windy shore at dawn with a hand shading her eyes, she turns a sharp, amused look on the viewer, counting the skiffs across the water. Face (most important: a round burnished bronze mirror at the hip catching the light, and a wind-burned face): a short, square, wind-burned face with deep creases from squinting, bright shrewd black eyes, thick brows, a wide humorous mouth, chapped red cheeks and small ears. Hair: black and iron-grey, in a thick short braid tied with sealskin cord. Body: short, solid and broad-shouldered, with square callused hands from oars. Clothing: a dark glossy sealskin cloak fastened with a bone toggle, rimed with salt at the cuff, over an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a grey-green sash and a coil of signal cord at the belt, and fur-lined boots laced with sinew. Hands and objects: the left hand shading the eyes; at the right hip a round polished bronze hand-mirror on a cord, flashing the dawn. Background: a vast pale lake stretching to a faint far shore beneath a line of grey cliffs, little skiffs lying like specks on the water. Light: cold pink dawn light from the upper left tinting the water, the bronze mirror throwing a tiny spark. Qi: a faint water-blue hint around her. Expression: an amused, pragmatic, sociable look, one brow lifted and the mouth wide, brave and shrewd, a woman who has watched this water for thirty years and enjoys being right about it.

people.imagined: He works the abacus of pine-nut beads without looking, eyes on the treasury roll in his head. He knows to the coin how poor seven vassals are.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk with his fingers flicking an abacus without looking down, eyes on the viewer, calm and precise. Face (most important: an abacus of brown pine-nut beads, flicked by quick fingers): a neat, round, clean-shaven face with a high rounded forehead, gentle exact grey eyes, small neat nose, a small mouth with a patient pursed look, smooth cheeks.
