His fingers are short and plump and move quick on the beads, and a neat line of tiredness runs under his eyes. Hair: black with grey at the temples, in a tidy topknot with a grey-green cord. Body: round, tidy, straight-backed. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe of excellent plain cloth with a grey-green elder's sash, white cuffs, tidy. The robe's cuffs are white and spotless and a small copper clasp holds the sash, with a thin silk cord and a seal pouch at his belt. Hands and objects: both hands on a wooden abacus whose beads are brown pine nuts; beside it a small iron strongbox. Background: a quiet counting room with ledgers on shelves. Shelves of tidy ledgers and a locked iron strongbox fill the room, with a window shuttered half closed. Light: soft light from the upper left. The soft light is calm and shows the polished beads gleaming. Expression: cautious, honest and temperate.

people.imagined: In the deep pines in the evening he wears the tiger-skin half-cape, claw marks still through it, and holds a name he is trying to learn the owner of.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dark pine wood in the evening, he looks at the viewer with a hard, scarred, impatient stare, the half-cape lifting, holding a name he is trying to learn the owner of. Face (most important: a tiger-skin half-cape on the left shoulder, striped orange and black, with four long claw slits cut through it): a lean, scarred, hawkish face with long pale claw scars across the left cheek and brow, hooded dark eyes, a straight nose, a tight jaw, a short grey-streaked beard and a thin white scar across the throat. Hair: black and grey, tied in a tight knot with a leather cord. Body: lean, wiry and upright, the neck cabled with sinew. Clothing: the tiger-skin half-cape, kept as a trophy, fastened with a bone pin over a good undyed pine-bark linen coat with a grey-green sash, leather bracers, long grey boots and a leather quiver at his back. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the haft of a long spear planted in the ground, the knuckles scarred. Background: tall dark pines receding into pale mist, a faint trail of paw marks in damp earth and a crow on a branch. Light: low gold light from the upper left catching the striped fur and the edge of the spear. Expression: a hard, impatient, loyal stare, the jaw tight and the eyes hooded, a brave hunter with the stillness of a man who waits only as long as he must.

people.imagined: Barefoot on the cold sand, salt in his beard, he looks at the tide as if it were a student; he means one day to walk out.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot at the waterline with the tide washing his ankles, he looks at the viewer with calm, remote eyes, at the cold sea as if it were a student, meaning one day to walk out. Face (most important: a long white beard stiff with salt, and bare feet in the surf): a gaunt, long, weathered face with high cheekbones, pale deep-set eyes, thick grey brows and chapped lips; the beard is crusted white with salt. Hair: grey, long and loose, damp with spray. Body: gaunt, tall and long-boned, with bony hands cracked by salt, bare pale feet and white salt dusting the shoulders. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with wide sleeves and a plain narrow grey-green sash, bleached with salt in white tide-lines at the hem and damp from the surf, with a bit of dried seaweed caught in the sash. Hands and objects: both hands hang loose at his sides; a small white shell on a cord at his neck. Background: a grey sea with slow waves rolling in white lines, a wide beach running to a far grey headland and an empty pavilion with a tiled roof on a rise. Light: cold grey light from the upper left, soft and silver, giving his skin a pale sheen. Qi: a faint sea-blue hint near the hands. Expression: a calm, remote, devout stillness, the eyes pale and unblinking and the mouth closed, a solitary man who is listening to the tide and who is almost ready.

people.imagined: She lifts a hand to show the soot under her nails; her sleeves smell of agarwood and cold plum. She wants one stick to burn an extra breath.
people.subject: The moment: seated, with one long sleeve held out toward the viewer as if offering its scent, her other hand showing a fingertip black with soot. Face: a tall, graceful, pale, fine-boned face, a long nose, calm slanted dark eyes, thin elegant brows, a small patient smile; a smudge of soot at the temple. Her hands are long and slim, the nails edged black with soot, and a faint scent of plum seems to rise from her sleeves. Hair: black, in a high coil with two plain wooden pins, a pale plum blossom tucked in it. Body: tall, slim and calm. Clothing: a long robe of undyed pine-bark linen, fine, with a grey-green elder's sash, wide sleeves lined in pale plum-pink silk. The robe is of fine pale cloth with the sleeves lined in plum-pink silk and a thin cord of black soot-stained cotton wound about the left wrist, with soft pale slippers. Hands and objects: the left sleeve held out; the right hand holds a slim unlit incense stick, fingernails visibly black with soot. Background: a garden courtyard with tall pale shrubs and a thin line of smoke. A garden court with a stone path and small bare plum trees lies behind her, and a thread of grey smoke curls up from a low brazier. Light: soft light from the upper left. The soft light is clear and cool and glows on the pink lining of the sleeve. Expression: patient, temperate and devout.

people.imagined: She pours tea for everyone before she lets them speak, in river-blue silk; she has not forgiven a smile.
people.subject: The moment: pouring tea from a small pot with a gracious sweep of the arm, she smiles warmly at the viewer, pouring for everyone before she lets them speak, in river-blue silk, having never forgiven a smile. Face (most important: a river-blue silk robe and a warm hostess's smile over unforgiving eyes): a handsome, composed, round-cheeked face with bright long almond eyes that hold steady and cold while the smile stays on, arched brows, full lips painted pale rose and a small beauty mark by the mouth. Hair: black, in a tall elegant coil with silver pins and a small pine-green jade. Body: shapely, composed and upright, with graceful pale hands and a jade bangle on the left wrist. Clothing: a long robe of river-blue silk with a high collar and wide sleeves, embroidered along the hem with a thin silver wave, an undyed linen under-robe visible at the neck, a grey-green sash tied in a flat elegant bow, and soft silver-grey slippers. Hands and objects: a small grey clay teapot in the right hand pouring into a tiny cup held in the left, with a thin thread of steam. Background: a pale hall with a low lacquered table, cushions, a second cup waiting and a screen painted only in soft grey. Light: warm light from the upper left shining on the silk and the stream of tea and leaving her eyes in a cool shade. Expression: a gracious, practised smile on the mouth with the eyes level and cold above it, the warmth of a hostess who is keeping a long account.

people.imagined: At the dusk listening she sings her son's name under her breath; a patrolman's wooden token hangs at her neck, river silt on her boots.
people.subject: The moment: standing at dusk on a dike, her lips parted as if singing very low, a hand closed round a wooden token at her neck, looking at the viewer. Face (most important: a small round wooden patrolman's token on a cord at her neck, gripped in her fist): a broad, strong, grey-haired woman's face, deep lines, tired grey eyes, a stubborn chin, a calm mouth shaped in a hum; sorrow held in. Her hands are broad and red with cracked knuckles, her lids are heavy, and her lips are dry and slightly parted in her hum. Hair: grey, in a tight low bun with a plain pine twig. Body: sturdy, square, upright. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a grey-green sash, river silt dried grey on her boots and hem, sleeves tied back. Silt grey as ash dusts her boots up to the ankle and the sash has been mended with a strip of different cloth, with a faded blue scarf at her neck. Hands and objects: the right hand closed round a round flat wooden token on a cord at her breast; the left rests on a dike post. Background: a dike at dusk, pale river and a few reeds. A long dike runs into a dusk haze with the river a wide pale band, with small lights from a village. Light: low gold dusk light from the upper left. The low gold light rests on her grey hair and the small wooden token in her fist. Expression: stubborn, patient and compassionate.

people.imagined: He stands at the fence of the grey pine vein in a cloak the colour of the pines, with a small cord of tokens in his hand, watching the border.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a wooden fence on a hillside, he looks suspiciously over it toward the border, then at the viewer. Face: a dark, square, hard face with a heavy brow, narrow suspicious dark eyes, a short thick black beard, a straight nose, a hard mouth; a faint grey tint at the temples. His hands are square with short thick fingers, his neck is thick, and a faint line of grey dust lies in the creases of his brow. Hair: black with a few grey hairs, in a short topknot. Body: stocky, broad and square. Clothing: a long cloak the exact dull grey of pine trunks over an undyed pine-bark linen coat, a grey-green sash, leather gauntlets. The cloak is clasped with a plain iron pin and the coat's collar is of dark grey wool, with iron-shod boots and a short knife on his belt. Hands and objects: a string of small brown tokens, each tied with a knot, held up in the right hand; the left grips the fence post. Background: grey pines on a ridge and a plain fence, with a pale sky. A line of weathered grey fence posts runs over a dark ridge, and the pine trunks are bare and tall in the mist. Light: cold light from the upper left. The cold light is flat and suits the grey of everything, with his dark face the only warm thing. Expression: paranoid, diligent and loyal. A faint iron-grey hint at the hands.

people.imagined: In the Pill Room he lifts a hand to show orange-stained fingertips; one eyebrow is singed away; he holds two hundred recipes in his head and he is afraid of forgetting.
people.subject: The moment: stooped over a furnace he lifts one hand with orange-stained fingertips and gives the viewer a kind, tired smile. Face (most important: orange-stained fingertips, and one eyebrow singed away, leaving the face lopsided): a long, gentle, tired face with a high forehead, one thick eyebrow on the left and none on the right, warm brown eyes, a drooping moustache, a shy smile. His fingertips are bright orange, his ears are long, and his remaining eyebrow is thin and grey, with a tiny scorch scar on his temple. Hair: grey, thin, in a small knot. Body: stooped, thin, long-armed. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with a grey-green sash, stained with orange at the cuffs, a leather apron with many small pockets. The apron's pockets are full of tiny labelled twists of paper with no writing, and the cuffs are stained orange, with felt slippers. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, fingertips bright orange; the left holds a tiny clay jar. Background: a small poor furnace room with shelves of jars, a warm glow. Rows of small clay jars with wax stoppers fill the shelves, and a little iron stove glows red at the corner, with herbs hung from the beam. Light: warm light from the lower right and soft light from the upper left. The warm light glows on his bald patch and lights the orange of his fingers like embers. Expression: humble, diligent and content; a little frightened of forgetting.

people.imagined: Memorial of the founder in the year 200, a hermit sitting alone in the pine sea, listening, about to found a palace he never intended to make so large.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of an aged hermit seated under a great pine listening with his eyes shut. Face: a long, lean, weathered face with a straight nose, a long white beard in a point, deep creases, closed eyes with heavy lids, a calm patient mouth with the faintest ambitious set. His hands are long and thin, laid open on his knees, and the skin of his face is lined like pine bark. Hair: long white hair, tied up in a loose knot with a bare pine twig. Body: lean, upright, seated cross-legged. Clothing: the undyed pine-bark linen robe, plain, loose, with no sash of rank, the sleeves wide, a coarse hemp rope belt. The robe's hem is covered with fallen needles and the hemp belt is knotted simply, with a bare pine twig pinned in his hair. Hands and objects: both hands lie on the knees, palms up; a few pine needles fallen on the shoulders. Background: a dense pine sea, tall dark trunks, pale mist. The pine sea stretches in every direction, with enormous trunks fading into soft mist, and a thin shaft of light falls through the canopy. Light: a faint gold from the upper left, fading like old paint. The paint is cracked in a fine web across the silk and its edges are brown and soft, leaving his face a pale oval. Expression: patient, reclusive, quietly ambitious. A faint wood-green haze.

people.imagined: Memorial of the governor on his quay in 905, refusing to go, lantern beside him, stubborn and loyal.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a stern man standing on a stone quay beside a lit lantern at night. Face (most important: a thin, long, straight nose and a cold stubborn mouth): a lean, hard, aristocratic face with a long thin straight nose, narrow dark eyes, thin lips set, a long grey beard in a neat point, high cheekbones. His hands are bony and veined, his shoulders are square, and a small mole sits on his right temple. Hair: black-grey, tied in a high official knot with a black pin. Body: tall, straight and stiff. Clothing: a long dark governor's robe over an undyed pine-bark linen under-robe, a heavy grey-green sash, a broad collar, a plain green stone seal at the belt. The long dark robe has a wide black collar edged in thin grey-green and the stone seal at his belt is carved as a coiled pine, with black cloth boots. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the head of a tall unlit staff; at his feet a paper lantern burning. Background: a stone quay, black water, a far dim shore. The quay is made of massive grey stones and the black water laps below, with the dim shape of a boat at a mooring post. Light: lantern glow from the lower left, fading like old paint. The yellowed silk is stained and darkened at the corners and the lantern glow looks like a faded amber stain. Expression: stubborn, loyal and callous; unmoving.

people.imagined: Memorial of the smith standing on the thousand-fathom chain as the fort breaks, hammer in hand, the iron streak in him barely taken by the canon.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a big smith on a huge iron chain with a hammer in hand, looking calm and stubborn. Face: a broad, heavy, soot-browned face with a flat nose, a thick black beard braided at the chin, bright determined eyes, thick brows, a scar across the cheek. His forearms are thick and burn-scarred, his hair is singed at the ends, and a spark-scar dots the bridge of his nose. Hair: black, tied up under a leather cap. Body: broad, muscular, shoulders like a bull. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen jerkin under a thick scorched leather smith's apron, sleeves cut off at the shoulder, forearms burn-scarred, a grey-green cord at the waist. The apron is of scorched leather with a long split at the hem and the boots are iron-capped, with a leather wrist guard on each arm. Hands and objects: a heavy smith's hammer held head-down in both hands; beneath his feet a massive iron chain, each link as big as a man's torso, going into a dark river. Background: a river gorge, a broken fortress wall and mist. The great chain runs from the foreground into the dark river, each link rough-forged, with a broken stone wall and mist. Light: dim light from the upper left, fading like old paint. The yellowed silk is cracked across the chain and the edges are dark with age. Expression: diligent, brave and stubborn.

people.imagined: Memorial of the River Hall master laying a sluice array on the quay, calm and pragmatic, in the year of the great flood.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of an old formation master crouching on a quay to set a small stone flag into a sluice in the year of the great flood. Face: a lean, careful, deeply lined face with a high forehead, a long nose, sharp patient eyes, a faint practical frown and a thin sparse white beard with a few drops of river water on it. Hair: white, tied in a plain knot. Body: wiry and bent, with thin tough hands and swollen knuckles. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe soaked dark at the hem, a grey-green elder's sash with a knotted measuring cord hanging from it, the sleeves tied up, and plain wooden clogs. Hands and objects: both hands set a small triangular stone flag into a gap in a sluice wall; a heap of such flags beside him. Background: a stone quay with a swollen river running close to its edge, a line of small stone flags marking a half-finished array behind him. Light: pale grey light from the upper left, fading like old paint, the yellowed silk faded at the corners so that the grey looks painted in thin washes. Expression: a pragmatic, cautious diligence, the frown small and the eyes on the work, an old master who has measured the flood and is not going to be hurried by it.

people.imagined: Memorial of the patrolman on the Cold Ford ice in 1172, sled behind him, loyal, honest, his deep cleft chin showing.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a patrolman standing on ice with a sled rope in his hand, looking calmly forward. Face (most important: a deep cleft chin, a straight mouth): a lean, strong, calm face with a deep cleft in the chin, level dark eyes, straight brows, a short beard line, wind-reddened cheekbones. His hands are strong and gloved in leather, the cheeks windburnt, and a thin frost clings to his beard line. Hair: black, in a knot with a grey-green cord. Body: tall, strong, steady. Clothing: a patrolman's short coat of undyed pine-bark linen with a fur collar, leather bracers, a needle-green sash, a round wooden token hung at the neck. The fur collar is worn pale at the edges and the token at his neck is a round wooden disc, plain and unmarked, with a green cord at his sword hilt. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a rope trailing off to a sled; the left rests on a sword hilt. Background: a flat grey ice plain, reeds at the edge, a thin sky. A flat grey ice plain stretches behind him with a single sled, a line of reeds, and a pale ghost of the far shore. Light: pale cold light from the upper left, fading like old paint. The yellowed silk darkens at the corners and the cold light looks like a faded wash of grey-blue. Expression: brave, loyal and honest.

people.imagined: Memorial of the son on the last rope bridge, a blade in his hand, about to cut the final rope, impatient and brave.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a young-looking man on a swaying rope bridge raising a black blade to cut the last rope. Face (most important: a broad fisher's jaw like his father's and a fierce impatient glare): a broad, handsome, weathered face with a square jaw, dark fierce eyes, thick brows, a flared nose, a short black beard and a thick white scar across the chin. Hair: black, tied in a high knot and windblown. Body: broad, strong and braced, with heavy shoulders and calloused palms. Clothing: a patrolman's short coat of undyed pine-bark linen with a needle-green sash, scuffed leather bracers, and a green cord tied about the hilt of a second knife at his belt. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted with a black flying blade, its edge down toward a thick rope; the left holds a bridge rope. Background: a pale rope bridge stretching over a deep river gorge with a few planks missing, a river far below and mist rising. Light: pale light from the upper left, fading like old paint, the yellowed silk cracked at the corners. Expression: a fierce, impatient glare, the jaw clenched and the eyes locked on the rope, brave and loyal, a man who has already decided what he will cut and what he will save.

people.imagined: Memorial of the first steward of the north in 345, laying a warm stone onto a village house with his own hands, generous and humble.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a kind steward with a flat stone in both hands, setting it onto a low wall. Face: a round, warm, humble face with a broad smile, bright small eyes, thick grey-black brows, a short beard, ruddy cheeks, stone dust on the brow. His hands are broad and chapped, stone dust is in the lines of his knuckles, and his round cheeks are red with cold. Hair: black with grey, in a plain knot under a straw hat. Body: stocky, strong, a little bent. Clothing: an undyed pine-bark linen robe with sleeves rolled to the elbow, a grey-green elder's sash, a mason's apron, mud-stained boots. The mason's apron is heavy with grey dust and the boots are wrapped with cloth against the snow, with a small hammer at his belt. Hands and objects: both hands hold a flat grey stone as if setting it into a wall; behind him a half-built house of stone, with a small fire glowing in its hearth. Background: a lake village in snow, small smoking roofs. Small low houses of grey stone with smoking chimneys line a snowy lake shore, and a few villagers carry stones, blurred. Light: warm light from the upper left, fading like old paint. The yellowed silk is soft and brown at the edges and the warm light from the hearth looks like a faded orange stain. Expression: generous, diligent and humble.
